```html
                    <div class="grow  rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 shadow-sm focus-within:border-indigo-600 focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-indigo-600">
                        <label for="s_endpoint" class="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-900">Endpoint</label>
                        <input x-model="search.s_endpoint" type="text" name="endpoint" id="endpoint"
                               class="block w-full border-0 p-0 text-gray-900 placeholder-gray-500 focus:ring-0 sm:text-sm"
                               placeholder="">
                    </div>

                </div>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mt-4">
                    <div>
                        <label for="type" class="mb-3 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-900">Type</label>

                        <select id="node-type" class="block w-full "
                                data-placeholder="Node type..."
                                data-allow-clear="true"></select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label for="status" class="mb-3 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-900">Status</label>

                        <select id="node-status" class="block w-full "
                                data-placeholder="Node status..."
                                data-allow-clear="true"></select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <span class="mt-4 isolate inline-flex rounded-md shadow-sm">
                  <a @click="executeSearch()"
                     class="relative cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center rounded-l-md border border-gray-300 bg-indigo-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-600 focus:z-10 focus:border-indigo-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-600">Search Nodes</a>
                  <a @click="resetSearch()"
                     class="relative cursor-pointer -ml-px inline-flex items-center rounded-r-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:z-10 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500">Reset Filters</a>
                </span>
            </div>
            {% if page.object_list.count > 0 %}
                <div class="flex flex-col mt-6">
                    <div class="-my-2 overflow-x-auto sm:-mx-6 lg:-mx-8">
                        <div class="py-2 align-middle min-w-full sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                            <div class="shadow overflow-hidden border-b border-gray-200 sm:rounded-lg">
                                <div class="overflow-x-auto">
                                    <table id="section-nodes" class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                        <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                        <tr>
                                            <th scope="col"
                                                class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                                Node Name
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col"
                                                class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                                Status
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col"
                                                class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                                Last Backup/Snapshot & Storage
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col"
                                                class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                                Integration
                                            </th>
                                            <th scope="col" class="relative px-6 py-3">
                                                <span class="sr-only">Actions</span>
                                            </th>
                                        </tr>
                                        </thead>
                                        <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                        {% for node in page.object_list %}
                                            <tr>
                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    <div class="flex items-center">
                                                        <div class="flex-shrink-0 h-10 w-10">
                                                            {% if node.type == 1 %}
                                                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                                     class="h-10 w-10 rounded-full text-indigo-600"
                                                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                                                     stroke="currentColor">
                                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                                                          stroke-width="2"
                                                                          d="M3 15a4 4 0 004 4h9a5 5 0 10-.1-9.999 5.002 5.002 0 10-9.78 2.096A4.001 4.001 0 003 15z"></path>
                                                                </svg>
                                                            {% elif node.type == 2 %}
                                                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                                     class="h-10 w-10 rounded-full text-indigo-600"
                                                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                                                     stroke="currentColor">
                                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                                                          stroke-width="2"
                                                                          d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4"></path>
                                                                </svg>
                                                            {% elif node.type == 3 %}
                                                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                                     class="h-10 w-10 rounded-full text-indigo-600"
                                                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                                                     stroke="currentColor">
                                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                                                          stroke-width="2"
                                                                          d="M5 12h14M5 12a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h14a2 2 0 012 2v4a2 2 0 01-2 2M5 12a2 2 0 00-2 2v4a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2m-2-4h.01M17 16h.01"></path>
                                                                </svg>
                                                            {% elif node.type == 4 %}
                                                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                                     class="h-10 w-10 rounded-full text-indigo-600"
                                                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                                                     stroke="currentColor">
                                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                                                          stroke-width="2"
                                                                          d="M4 7v10c0 2.21 3.582 4 8 4s8-1.79 8-4V7M4 7c0 2.21 3.582 4 8 4s8-1.79 8-4M4 7c0-2.21 3.582-4 8-4s8 1.79 8 4m0 5c0 2.21-3.582 4-8 4s-8-1.79-8-4"></path>
                                                                </svg>
                                                            {% elif node.type == 5 %}
                                                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                                     class="h-10 w-10 rounded-full text-indigo-600"
                                                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                                                                     stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                                                          d="M4 5a1 1 0 011-1h14a1 1 0 011 1v2a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1V5zM4 13a1 1 0 011-1h6a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6zM16 13a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1h-2a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6z"></path>
                                                                </svg>
                                                            {% endif %}
                                                        </div>
                                                        <div class="ml-4">
                                                            <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                                <a href="{% url 'console:node:detail' node.id %}">{{ node.name|truncatechars:45 }}</a>
                                                            </div>
                                                            <div class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                                                {{ node.connection.integration.name }}
                                                            </div>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    {% if node.status == 1 or node.status == 2 %}
                                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                                                                {{ node.get_status_display }}
                                                        </span>
                                                    {% elif node.status == 3 %}
                                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                                                            {{ node.get_status_display }}
                                                        </span>
                                                    {% elif node.status == 4 %}
                                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800">
                                                            {{ node.get_status_display }}
                                                        </span>
                                                    {% elif node.status == 6 or node.status == 8 %}
                                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">
                                                            {{ node.get_status_display }}
                                                        </span>
                                                    {% else %}
                                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800">
                                                            {{ node.get_status_display }}
                                                        </span>
                                                    {% endif %}
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-700">{{ node.last_backup_date|default:"n/a" }}</div>
                                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-700">{{ node.total_storage|default:"n/a" }}</div>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="px-6 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-700"><a class="text-sm text-gray-700"
                                                                                          href="{% url 'console:setup:integration_open' integration_code=node.connection.integration.code %}?i_name={{ node.connection.name }}">
                                                        {{ node.connection.name|truncatechars:25 }}</a></div>
                                                    <div class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                                        {{ node.connection.location.location }}
                                                    </div>
                                                </td>


                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                                    <a target="_blank"
                                                       href="{% url 'console:log:index' %}?node={{ node.id }}"
                                                       type="button"
                                                       class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Logs
                                                    </a>
                                                    <a href="{% url 'console:node:detail' node.id %}" type="button"
                                                       class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">

                                                        Open
                                                    </a>
                                                    <button @click="openModal('{{ node.id }}','{{ node.name }}','{{ node.connection.location.id }}','{{ node.connection.integration.code }}','{{ node.type }}')"
                                                            type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5  border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        {% if node.type == 3 or node.type == 4 or node.type == 5 %}
                                                            Backup{% else %}Snapshot{% endif %}
                                                    </button>
                                                </td>
                                            </tr>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                        </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <nav class="border-t border-gray-200 px-4 flex items-center justify-between sm:px-0 mt-4">
                    <div class="-mt-px w-0 flex-1 flex">
                        {% if page.has_previous %}
                            <a @click="executeSearch({{ page.previous_page_number }},{{ page.paginator.per_page }})"
                               class="cursor-pointer border-t-2 border-transparent pt-4 pr-1 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300">
                                <!-- Heroicon name: solid/arrow-narrow-left -->
                                <svg class="mr-3 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                     viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                          d="M7.707 14.707a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 010-1.414l4-4a1 1 0 011.414 1.414L5.414 9H17a1 1 0 110 2H5.414l2.293 2.293a1 1 0 010 1.414z"
                                          clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Previous
                            </a>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="hidden md:-mt-px md:flex">
                        {% for page_no in elided_page_range %}
                            <!-- Current: "border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600", Default: "border-transparent text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300" -->
                            {% if page_no == "…" %}
                                <a class="{% if page.number ==  page_no %}border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600{% else %}cursor-pointer border-transparent text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300{% endif %} border-t-2 pt-4 px-4 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                                    {{ page_no }}
                                </a>
                            {% else %}
                                <a @click="executeSearch({{ page_no }},{{ page.paginator.per_page }})"
                                   class="{% if page.number ==  page_no %}border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600{% else %}cursor-pointer border-transparent text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300{% endif %} border-t-2 pt-4 px-4 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                                    {{ page_no }}
                                </a>
                            {% endif %}
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="-mt-px w-0 flex-1 flex justify-end">
                        {% if page.has_next %}
                            <a @click="executeSearch({{ page.next_page_number }},{{ page.paginator.per_page }})"
                               class="border-t-2 cursor-pointer  border-transparent pt-4 pl-1 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300">
                                Next
                                <!-- Heroicon name: solid/arrow-narrow-right -->
                                <svg class="ml-3 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                     viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                          d="M12.293 5.293a1 1 0 011.414 0l4 4a1 1 0 010 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L14.586 11H3a1 1 0 110-2h11.586l-2.293-2.293a1 1 0 010-1.414z"
                                          clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                </svg>
                            </a>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </nav>
                <div x-show="open" style="display: none;" class="fixed z-10 inset-0 overflow-y-auto"
                     aria-labelledby="modal-title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
                    <div class="flex items-end justify-center min-h-screen pt-4 px-4 pb-20 text-center sm:block sm:p-0">
                        <div x-show="open"
                             x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                             x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
                             x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
                             x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                             x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                             x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                             class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity"
                             aria-hidden="true"></div>

                        <span class="hidden sm:inline-block sm:align-middle sm:h-screen"
                              aria-hidden="true">&#8203;</span>

                        <div x-show="open"
                             x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                             x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                             x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                             x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                             x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                             x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                             class="inline-block align-bottom bg-white rounded-lg px-4 pt-5 pb-4 text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl transform transition-all sm:my-8 sm:align-middle sm:max-w-lg sm:w-full sm:p-6">
                            <div>
                                <div class="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-indigo-500">
                                    <svg x-show="loading" class="animate-spin h-10 w-10 text-white"
                                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                        <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor"
                                                stroke-width="4"></circle>
                                        <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor"
                                              d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                    <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                         fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                              d="M8 9l3 3-3 3m5 0h3M5 20h14a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                                    <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                        Create <span
                                            x-show="node_type==='3'||node_type==='4'||node_type==='5'">Backup</span><span
                                            x-show="node_type!=='3' && node_type!=='4' && node_type!=='5'">Snapshot</span>
                                    </h3>
                                    <div class="mt-2">
                                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                            You are about to create on-demand <span
                                                x-show="node_type==='3'||node_type==='4'||node_type==='5'">backup</span><span
                                                x-show="node_type!=='3' && node_type!=='4' && node_type!=='5'">snapshot</span>
                                            of <br/><strong
                                                x-text="node_name"></strong>
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div x-show="loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                                    <h4 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                        Requesting <span x-show="node_type==='3'||node_type==='4'||node_type==='5'">Backup</span><span
                                            x-show="node_type!=='3' && node_type!=='4' && node_type!=='5'">Snapshot</span>...
                                    </h4>
                                    <div class="mt-2">
                                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                            Requesting on-demand <span
                                                x-show="node_type==='3'||node_type==='4'||node_type==='5'">backup</span><span
                                                x-show="node_type!=='3' && node_type!=='4' && node_type!=='5'">snapshot</span>
                                            for <br/><strong x-text="node_name"></strong>
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div x-show="integration_code==='website'||integration_code==='database'||integration_code==='wordpress'">
                                    <div x-show="!loading" class="sm:col-span-6  mt-4">
                                        <h4 class="font-medium text-gray-700">
                                            Storage Locations (<span
                                                x-text="onDemandBackup.storage_point_ids.length"></span>)
                                        </h4>
                                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                            Select where you want to store backups for this backup run.
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div x-show="!loading" class="sm:col-span-6">
                                        <fieldset class="overflow-auto h-32">
                                            <div class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                                {% for storage in storage_list %}
                                                    <div class="relative flex items-start py-4 px-1">
                                                        <div class="flex items-center h-5">
                                                            <input id="ondemand-storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                                   aria-describedby="ondemand-storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                                   name="storage-{{ storage.id }}" type="checkbox"
                                                                   value="{{ storage.id }}"
                                                                   x-model="onDemandBackup.storage_point_ids"
                                                                   class="focus:ring-indigo-500 h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 border-gray-300 rounded">
                                                        </div>
                                                        <div class="ml-3 text-sm">
                                                            <label for="ondemand-storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                                   class="font-medium text-gray-700">{{ storage.name }}
                                                                {% if storage.type.code == "bs" %}
                                                                    <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800"> Default </span>
                                                                {% endif %}
                                                            </label>
                                                            <p id="comments-description"
                                                               class="text-gray-700">{{ storage.type.name }}</p>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                {% endfor %}
                                            </div>
                                        </fieldset>
                                        <p x-show="onDemandBackupErrors.storage_point_ids"
                                           class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                           id="ondemand-storage-error"
                                           x-text="onDemandBackupErrors.storage_point_ids"></p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-left sm:mt-5">
                                    <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                        <label for="about" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                            Notes
                                        </label>
                                        <div class="mt-1">
                                        <textarea x-model="onDemandBackup.notes" id="about" name="about" rows="3"
                                                  class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-md"></textarea>
                                        </div>
                                        <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-700">Optional notes about the <span
                                                x-show="node_type==='3'||node_type==='4'||node_type==='5'">backup</span><span
                                                x-show="node_type!=='3' && node_type!=='4' && node_type!=='5'">snapshot</span>.
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div x-show="!loading"
                                 class="mt-5 sm:mt-6 sm:grid sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-3 sm:grid-flow-row-dense">
                                <button @click="createBackup()" type="button"
                                        class="w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-base font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:col-start-2 sm:text-sm">
                                    Create <span
                                        x-show="node_type==='3'||node_type==='4'||node_type==='5'">Backup</span><span
                                        x-show="node_type!=='3' && node_type!=='4' && node_type!=='5'">Snapshot</span>
                                </button>
                                <button @click="closeModal()" type="button"
                                        class="mt-3 w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-white text-base font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:mt-0 sm:col-start-1 sm:text-sm">
                                    Cancel
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            {% else %}
                <div class="text-center">
                    <h2 class="mt-2 text-gray-900">No nodes found with search filters</h2>
                    <div class="mt-6">
                        <button type="button"
                                class="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-transparent shadow-sm text-sm font-medium rounded-md text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                @click="resetSearch()">Reset Filters
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        <script>
            document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
                Alpine.data('nodeListPage', () => ({
                    open: false,
                    node_id: null,
                    node_name: null,
                    integration_code: null,
                    notes: null,
                    node_type: null,
                    loading: null,
                    onDemandBackup: {
                        storage_point_ids: [],
                    },
                    search: {
                        s_node: null,
                        s_integration: null,
                        s_status: null,
                        s_endpoint: null,
                        s_type: null,
                        p_no: null,
                        p_size: null,
                    },
                    onDemandBackupErrors: {},
                    init() {
                        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
                        const searchParams = url.searchParams;

                        if (searchParams.get('s_node')) {
                            this.search.s_node = searchParams.get('s_node');
                        }
                        if (searchParams.get('s_integration')) {
                            this.search.s_integration = searchParams.get('s_integration');
                        }
                        if (searchParams.get('s_status')) {
                            this.search.s_status = parseInt(searchParams.get('s_status'));
                        }
                        if (searchParams.get('s_endpoint')) {
                            this.search.s_endpoint = searchParams.get('s_endpoint');
                        }

                        $(document).ready(function () {
                            let nodeStatusOptions = [
                                {
                                    id: '1',
                                    text: 'Active'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '3',
                                    text: 'Backup In-Progress'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '4',
                                    text: 'Retrying Backup'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '6',
                                    text: 'Paused'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '8',
                                    text: 'Paused (Max Retries)'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '7',
                                    text: 'Delete Requested'
                                }
                            ];
                            let nodeTypeOptions = [
                                {
                                    id: '1',
                                    text: 'Cloud'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '2',
                                    text: 'Volume'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '3',
                                    text: 'Website'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '4',
                                    text: 'Database'
                                },
                                {
                                    id: '5',
                                    text: 'SaaS'
                                },
                            ];

                            /**
                             * Node Status
                             */
                            if (searchParams.get('s_status')) {
                                let nodeStatusOption = _.find(nodeStatusOptions, {'id': searchParams.get('s_status')});
                                if (nodeStatusOption) {
                                    nodeStatusOption.selected = true;
                                }
                            } else {
                                setTimeout(function () {
                                    $("#node-status").val(null).trigger('change');
                                }, 500);
                            }
                            /**
                             * Initiate Dropdown
                             */
                            $("#node-status").select2({
                                data: nodeStatusOptions,
                            });

                            /**
                             * Node Type
                             */
                            if (searchParams.get('s_type')) {
                                let nodeTypeOption = _.find(nodeTypeOptions, {'id': searchParams.get('s_type')});
                                if (nodeTypeOption) {
                                    nodeTypeOption.selected = true;
                                }
                            } else {
                                setTimeout(function () {
                                    $("#node-type").val(null).trigger('change');
                                }, 500);
                            }
                            /**
                             * Initiate Dropdown
                             */
                            $("#node-type").select2({
                                data: nodeTypeOptions,
                            });

                        });
                    },

                    openModal(node_id, node_name, location_id, integration_code, node_type) {
                        this.loading = false;
                        this.open = true;
                        this.node_id = node_id;
                        this.location_id = location_id;
                        this.node_name = node_name;
                        this.integration_code = integration_code;
                        this.node_type = node_type;
                    },
                    closeModal() {
                        this.open = false;
                    },
                    async createBackup() {
                        this.loading = true;

                        let url = "/api/proxy/nodes/" + this.node_id + "/take_snapshot/?" + new URLSearchParams({
                            location: this.location_id,
                        });

                        let data = {
                            location: this.location_id,
                            notes: this.onDemandBackup.notes,
                            storage_point_ids: this.onDemandBackup.storage_point_ids,
                        }

                        let response = await fetch(url, {
                            headers: {
                                'Accept': 'application/json',
                                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                            },
                            method: 'POST',
                            body: JSON.stringify(data)
                        }).then(async (response) => {
                            this.loading = false;
                            if (response.ok) {
                                return response.json();
                            } else {
                                let json;
                                try {
                                    json = await response.json();
                                } catch (exception_var) {
                                    json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                                }

                                this.onDemandBackupErrors = json;
                                throw new Error(json.detail);
                            }
                        }).then((json) => {
                            Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                show: true,
                                success: true,
                                heading: 'Success!',
                                details: json.detail
                            });
                            this.closeModal();
                        }).catch((error) => {
                            Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                show: true,
                                error: true,
                                heading: 'Error!',
                                details: error.message
                            });
                        });
                    },
                    executeSearch(p_no, p_size) {
                        if(p_no){
                            this.search.p_no = p_no;
                        }
                        if(p_size){
                            this.search.p_size = p_size;
                        }
                        /**
                         * Node Status
                         */
                        if($('#node-status').select2('data').length > 0) {
                            this.search.s_status = $('#node-status').select2('data')[0].id
                        }
                        else {
                            this.search.s_status = null;
                        }

                        /**
                         * Node Type
                         */
                        if($('#node-type').select2('data').length > 0) {
                            this.search.s_type = $('#node-type').select2('data')[0].id
                        }
                        else {
                            this.search.s_type = null;
                        }

                        let url = "/console/nodes/?" + new URLSearchParams(_.omitBy(this.search, _.isNull));
                        window.location.href = url+"#section-nodes";
                    },
                    resetSearch() {
                        let url = "/console/nodes/";
                        window.location.href = url;
                    }
                }));
            });



        </script>
    {% else %}
        {% include "console/_welcome.html" %}
    {% endif %}

{% endblock %}
```

### `apps/console/_templates/console/node/detail.html`

```html
{% extends "console/_master.html" %}
{% block title %}{{ heading }}{% endblock %}
{% block meta_title %}{{ heading }}{% endblock %}
{% block meta_description %}{{ heading }}{% endblock %}
{% block meta_keywords %}{{ heading }}{% endblock %}
{% block page_class %}page_console console-page sb-l-o sb-r-c{% endblock %}
{% block heading %}false{% endblock %}
{% load humanize %}

{% block content %}
    <div x-data="nodeDetails('{{ object.notify_on_success|yesno:"true,false" }}', '{{ object.notify_on_fail|yesno:"true,false" }}')">
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
                <div class="bg-white shadow overflow-hidden sm:rounded-lg">
                    <div class="px-2 py-3 sm:px-2  bg-indigo-500">
                        <h3 class="text-lg leading-6  text-white">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                 viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z"></path>
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Actions
                        </h3>
                    </div>
                    <div class="border-t border-gray-200 px-4 py-5 sm:px-6">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-center">
                            <button @click="openBackupModal()" type="button"
                                    class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                Create {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}Backup{% else %}
                                Snapshot{% endif %}
                            </button>
                            <button @click="openScheduleModal()" type="button"
                                    class="inline-flex items-center  mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                Add Schedule
                            </button>
                            {% if object.type == 1 or object.type == 2 %}
                                <button @click="openModifyModal()" type="button"
                                        class="inline-flex items-center  mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                    Modify
                                </button>
                            {% elif object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 %}
                                <a href="{% url 'console:setup:integration_modify_node' integration_code=object.get_type_display|lower connection_id=object.connection.id object_code='objects' node_id=object.id %}"
                                   class="inline-flex items-center  mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                    Modify
                                </a>
                            {% elif object.type == 5 %}
                                <a href="{% url 'console:setup:integration_modify_node' integration_code=object.get_integration_alt_code|lower connection_id=object.connection.id object_code='objects' node_id=object.id %}"
                                   class="inline-flex items-center  mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                    Modify
                                </a>
                            {% endif %}

                            {% if object.status == 1 %}

                                <button @click="openPauseBackupsModal()" type="button"
                                        class="inline-flex items-center  mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                    Pause
                                </button>

                            {% elif object.status == 6 or object.status == 8 %}
                                <button @click="openResumeBackupsModal()" type="button"
                                        class="inline-flex items-center  mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                    Resume
                                </button>
                            {% endif %}
                            <button @click="openDeleteNodeModal()" type="button"
                                    class="inline-flex items-center  mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                Delete
                            </button>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="bg-white shadow overflow-hidden sm:rounded-lg">
                    <div class="px-2 py-3 sm:px-2  bg-indigo-500">
                        <h3 class="text-lg leading-6  text-white">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                 viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Notifications
                        </h3>
                    </div>
                    <div class="border-t border-gray-200 px-4 py-6 pb-7 sm:px-6">
                        <dl class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 sm:grid-cols-2">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <div class="flex items-center">
                                    <!-- Enabled: "bg-indigo-600", Not Enabled: "bg-gray-200" -->
                                    <button type="button"
                                            @click="toggleNotification('success')"
                                            :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': notify_on_success, 'bg-gray-200': !(notify_on_success) }"
                                            class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                            role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                        <!-- Enabled: "translate-x-5", Not Enabled: "translate-x-0" -->
                                        <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': notify_on_success, 'translate-x-0': !(notify_on_success) }"
                                              aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                    </button>
                                    <span class="ml-3" id="annual-billing-label">
                                        <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Notify On Success </span>
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <div class="flex items-center">
                                    <!-- Enabled: "bg-indigo-600", Not Enabled: "bg-gray-200" -->
                                    <button type="button"
                                            @click="toggleNotification('fail')"
                                            :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': notify_on_fail, 'bg-gray-200': !(notify_on_fail) }"
                                            class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                            role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                        <!-- Enabled: "translate-x-5", Not Enabled: "translate-x-0" -->
                                        <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': notify_on_fail, 'translate-x-0': !(notify_on_fail) }"
                                              aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                    </button>
                                    <span class="ml-3" id="annual-billing-label">
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Notify On Failure </span>
                              </span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </dl>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
                <div class="bg-white shadow overflow-hidden sm:rounded-lg mt-6">
                    <div class="px-2 py-3 sm:px-2  bg-indigo-500">
                        <h3 class="text-lg leading-6  text-white">
                            {% if object.type == 1 %}
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                     viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M3 15a4 4 0 004 4h9a5 5 0 10-.1-9.999 5.002 5.002 0 10-9.78 2.096A4.001 4.001 0 003 15z"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 2 %}
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                     viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 3 %}
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                     viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M5 12h14M5 12a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h14a2 2 0 012 2v4a2 2 0 01-2 2M5 12a2 2 0 00-2 2v4a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2m-2-4h.01M17 16h.01"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 4 %}
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                     viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M4 7v10c0 2.21 3.582 4 8 4s8-1.79 8-4V7M4 7c0 2.21 3.582 4 8 4s8-1.79 8-4M4 7c0-2.21 3.582-4 8-4s8 1.79 8 4m0 5c0 2.21-3.582 4-8 4s-8-1.79-8-4"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 5 %}
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                     viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                          d="M4 5a1 1 0 011-1h14a1 1 0 011 1v2a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1V5zM4 13a1 1 0 011-1h6a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6zM16 13a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1h-2a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6z"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% endif %}
                            Node
                        </h3>
                    </div>
                    <div class="border-t border-gray-200 px-4 py-5 sm:px-6">
                        <dl class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 sm:grid-cols-3">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Status (<a @click="openResumeBackupsModal()" class="text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer">reset</a>)
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {% if object.status == 1 or object.status == 2 %}
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                                            {{ object.get_status_display }}
                                        </span>
                                    {% elif object.status == 3 %}
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-blue-100 text-blue-800">
                                            {{ object.get_status_display }}
                                        </span>
                                    {% elif object.status == 4 %}
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800">
                                            {{ object.get_status_display }}
                                        </span>
                                    {% elif object.status == 6 or object.status == 8 %}
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">
                                            {{ object.get_status_display }}
                                        </span>
                                    {% else %}
                                        <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800">
                                            {{ object.get_status_display }}
                                        </span>
                                    {% endif %}
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}Backups  {% if object.type == 3 %}{% if object.website.backup_type == 2 or object.website.backup_type == 3 %}(<a class="text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer" @click="openIncrementalResetModal()">reset</a>){% endif %}{% endif %}{% else %}
                                        Snapshots{% endif %}
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {{ object.total_backups|default:0 }} {% if object.type == 3 %}({{ object.website.get_backup_type_display }}){% endif %}
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Storage {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                {% else %}
                                    ({{ object.connection.integration.name }})
                                {% endif %}
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {{ object.total_storage|default:"n/a" }}
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Last {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                    Backup{% else %}
                                    Snapshot{% endif %}
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {{ object.last_backup_date|default:"n/a" }}
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Connected
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {{ object.created }}
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Logs
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    <a href="{% url 'console:log:index' %}?node={{ object.id }}"
                                       class="text-indigo-600">
                                        view node logs
                                    </a>
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                        </dl>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="bg-white shadow overflow-hidden sm:rounded-lg mt-6">
                    <div class="px-2 py-3 sm:px-2  bg-indigo-500">
                        <h3 class="text-lg leading-6  text-white">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                 viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z"></path>
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Integration
                        </h3>
                    </div>
                    <div class="border-t border-gray-200 px-4 py-5 sm:px-6">
                        <dl class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-4 gap-y-8 sm:grid-cols-3">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Type
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {{ object.connection.integration.name }}
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Name
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    <a class="text-indigo-500"
                                       href="{% url 'console:setup:integration_open' integration_code=object.connection.integration.code %}?i_name={{ object.connection.name }}">{{ object.connection.name|truncatechars:25 }}</a>
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Status
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {{ object.connection.get_status_display }} (<a
                                        class="text-indigo-500 cursor-pointer"
                                        @click="validateConnection()">validate</a>)
                                </dd>
                            </div>
{#                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">#}
{#                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">#}
{#                                    Endpoint Region#}
{#                                </dt>#}
{#                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">#}
{#                                    <img class="pull-left float-left mr-1" width="20"#}
{#                                         src="{{ object.connection.location.image_url }}"#}
{#                                         alt="{{ object.connection.location.name }}"> {{ object.connection.location.location }}#}
{#                                </dd>#}
{#                            </div>#}

                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Backup Server
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    {{ object.connection.location.location }}
                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Backup Server IPv4
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    <a @click="$clipboard('{{ object.connection.location.ip_address }}')"
                                       class="cursor-pointer">{{ object.connection.location.ip_address }}</a>

                                </dd>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-1">
                                <dt class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Backup Server IPv6
                                </dt>
                                <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    <a @click="$clipboard('{{ object.connection.location.ip_address_v6 }}')"
                                       class="cursor-pointer">{{ object.connection.location.ip_address_v6 }}</a>
                                </dd>
                            </div>

                        </dl>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 mt-6">
            <div class="bg-white shadow overflow-hidden sm:rounded-lg  ">

                {% if object.schedules.count > 0 %}
                    <div class="px-2 py-3 sm:px-2  bg-indigo-500">
                        <h3 class="text-lg leading-6  text-white">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                 viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Schedules ({{ object.schedules.count|default:0 }})
                        </h3>
                    </div>

                    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
                        <table class="table-auto min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200 ">
                            <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                            <tr>
                                <th scope="col"
                                    class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    Name
                                </th>
                                <th scope="col"
                                    class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    Status
                                </th>
                                <th scope="col"
                                    class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    Timezone
                                </th>
                                <th scope="col"
                                    class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    When
                                </th>
                                <th scope="col"
                                    class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    Retention
                                </th>
                                <th scope="col" class="relative px-4 py-2">
                                    <span class="sr-only">Actions</span>
                                </th>
                            </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                            {% for schedule in object.schedules.filter %}
                                <tr>
                                    <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                            {{ schedule.name }}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                    <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                            {% if schedule.status == 1 %}
                                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                                        {{ schedule.get_status_display }}
                                    </span>
                                            {% elif schedule.status == 2 %}
                                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">
                                        {{ schedule.get_status_display }}
                                    </span>
                                            {% elif schedule.status == 3 %}
                                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800">
                                        {{ schedule.get_status_display }}
                                    </span>
                                            {% endif %}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                    <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                            {{ schedule.timezone }}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                    <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                            {% if schedule.type == "cron" %}
                                                {{ schedule.aws_schedule_expression }}
                                            {% elif schedule.type == "rate" %}
                                                Every {{ schedule.rate_value }} {{ schedule.rate_unit }}
                                            {% elif schedule.type == "at" %}
                                               At {{ schedule.at_datetime }}
                                            {% endif %}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                    <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                        <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                            {{ schedule.keep_last|default:'unlimited' }}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>

                                    <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                        {% if schedule.status == 3 %}
                                            <button @click="resumeSchedule('{{ schedule.id }}')" type="button"
                                                    class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                Undo
                                            </button>
                                        {% else %}
                                            <button @click="openScheduleModal('{{ schedule.id }}')" type="button"
                                                    class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                Modify
                                            </button>
                                            {% if schedule.status == 1 %}
                                                <button @click="pauseSchedule('{{ schedule.id }}')" type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Pause
                                                </button>
                                            {% elif schedule.status == 2 %}
                                                <button @click="resumeSchedule('{{ schedule.id }}')" type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Resume
                                                </button>
                                            {% endif %}

                                            <button @click="deleteSchedule('{{ schedule.id }}')" type="button"
                                                    class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                Delete
                                            </button>

                                        {% endif %}
                                    </td>
                                </tr>
                            {% endfor %}
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                    </div>

                {% else %}
                    <button @click="openScheduleModal()" type="button"
                            class="relative block w-full border-2 border-gray-300 border-dashed rounded-lg p-12 text-center hover:border-gray-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
```
