                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="mx-auto h-12 w-12 text-gray-400" fill="none"
                             viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                  d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="mt-2 block text-sm font-medium text-indigo-500">
                            Create a new schedule
                          </span>
                    </button>
                {% endif %}

            </div>
        </div>

        {% if backup_count > 0 %}
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 mt-6" id="section-backup">
                <div>
                    <div class="bg-white shadow overflow-hidden sm:rounded-lg">
                        <div class="px-2 py-3 sm:px-2  bg-indigo-500">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6  text-white">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 float-left mr-1" fill="none"
                                     viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z"></path>
                                </svg>
                                {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}Backups{% else %}
                                    Snapshots{% endif %}
                                ({{ page.paginator.count|default:0 }})

                                <span class="ml-3 float-right" id="annual-billing-label">
                                    <span class="text-lg leading-6 text-white">Show all
                                        {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}backups{% else %}
                                            snapshots{% endif %}
                                    </span>
                                </span>
                                <button type="button"
                                        @click="toggleBackups()"
                                        :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': list_all_backups, 'bg-gray-200': !(list_all_backups) }"
                                        class="float-right bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                        role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                    <!-- Enabled: "translate-x-5", Not Enabled: "translate-x-0" -->
                                    <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': list_all_backups, 'translate-x-0': !(list_all_backups) }"
                                          aria-hidden="true"
                                          class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                </button>
                            </h3>

                        </div>
                        <div class="overflow-x-auto">
                            <table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                <tr>
                                    <th scope="col"
                                        class="px-4 py-4 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                        Created
                                    </th>
                                    <th scope="col"
                                        class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                        Status
                                    </th>
                                    <th scope="col"
                                        class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                        Type
                                    </th>
                                    <th scope="col"
                                        class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                        Size
                                    </th>
                                    {% if object.type == 3 %}
{#                                        {% if object.website.backup_type == 1 %}#}
                                            <th scope="col"
                                                class="px-4 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                                Files
                                            </th>
{#                                        {% endif %}#}
                                    {% endif %}

                                    <th scope="col"
                                        class="relative px-4 py-2 text-center text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    </th>
                                </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                {% for backup in page.object_list %}
                                    <tr>
                                        <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                <svg @click="$clipboard('{{ backup.uuid }}')"
                                                     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                     class="h-5 w-5 float-left text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer"
                                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                                                     stroke-width="2">
                                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                                          d="M8 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-1M8 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M8 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m0 0h2a2 2 0 012 2v3m2 4H10m0 0l3-3m-3 3l3 3"></path>
                                                </svg>
                                                {{ backup.created }}
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                {% if backup.status == 3 %}
                                                    <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-green-100 text-green-800">
                                                    {{ backup.get_status_display }}
                                                </span>
                                                {% elif backup.status == 4 or backup.status == 11 or backup.status == 12 or backup.status == 13 or backup.status == 15  or backup.status == 20  or backup.status == 16 %}
                                                    <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-800">
                                                    {{ backup.get_status_display }}
                                                </span>
                                                {% elif backup.status == 5 or backup.status == 7 or backup.status == 14 or backup.status == 19 %}
                                                    <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800">
                                                    {{ backup.get_status_display }}
                                                </span>
                                                {% else %}
                                                    <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800">
                                                    {{ backup.get_status_display }}
                                                </span>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </div>
                                        </td>

                                        <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                            <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                {{ backup.get_type_display }}
                                                {% if backup.type == 2 %}
                                                    <small>({{ backup.schedule.name|default:"n/a"|truncatechars:16 }})</small>{% endif %}
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
{#                                        {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}#}
                                            <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {% if backup.status == 2 or backup.status == 6 or backup.status == 5 or backup.status == 9 or backup.status == 10 or backup.status == 17 or backup.status == 18 %}
                                                        <svg class="animate-spin h-6 w-6 text-indigo-600"
                                                             xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none"
                                                             viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                                            <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10"
                                                                    stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"></circle>
                                                            <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor"
                                                                  d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
                                                        </svg>
                                                    {% else %}
                                                        {{ backup.size_display }}
                                                    {% endif %}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
{#                                        {% endif %}#}
                                        {% if object.type == 3 %}
{#                                            {% if object.website.backup_type == 1 %}#}
                                                 <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ backup.total_files|default:0|intcomma }}
                                                    </div>
                                                 </td>
{#                                            {% endif %}#}
                                        {% endif %}
                                        <td class="px-4 py-2 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">

                                            {% if backup.status == 3 %}
                                                {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                                    <button @click="openBackupDownloadModal('{{ backup.id }}', '{{ backup.uuid }}')"
                                                            type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Download
                                                    </button>
                                                {% endif %}
                                                {#                                              <button @click="openBackupDeleteModal('{{ object.connection.integration.code }}', '{{ backup.id }}', '{{ backup.uuid }}')" type="button"#}
                                                {#                                                      class="-ml-px relative inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 bg-white text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:z-10 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500">#}
                                                {#                                                Delete#}
                                                {#                                              </button>#}
                                                <button @click="openBackupDeleteModal('{{ object.connection.integration.code }}', '{{ backup.id }}', '{{ backup.uuid }}')"
                                                        type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Delete
                                                </button>
                                            {% elif backup.status == 2 or backup.status == 5 or backup.status == 8 or backup.status == 9 or backup.status == 10  or backup.status == 11 or backup.status == 17 or backup.status == 18 %}
                                                <button @click="cancelBackup('{{ backup.id }}')" type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Cancel
                                                </button>
                                            {% elif backup.status == 7 %}
{#                                                <button @click="cancelBackup('{{ backup.id }}')" type="button"#}
{#                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">#}
{#                                                    Retry#}
{#                                                </button>#}
                                            {% elif backup.status == 15 %}
                                                {#                                              <button @click="" type="button"#}
                                                {#                                                      class="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">#}
                                                {#                                                Logs#}
                                                {#                                              </button>#}
                                                <!-- DELETE_COMPLETED -->
                                            {% elif backup.status == 14 %}
                                                {#                                              <button @click="" type="button"#}
                                                {#                                                      class="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">#}
                                                {#                                                Logs#}
                                                {#                                              </button>#}
                                            {% endif %}

                                            {% if object.type == 1 and object.type == 2 %}
                                                <a href="{% url 'console:log:index' %}?backup={{ backup.id }}"
                                                   class="cursor-pointer  inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Logs
                                                </a>
                                            {% endif %}
                                            {% if backup.show_transfer_log and object.type == 3 %}
                                                {% if backup.status == 3 or backup.status == 4 or backup.status == 11 or backup.status == 12 or backup.status == 13 or backup.status == 15  or backup.status == 20  or backup.status == 16  or backup.status == 19  or backup.status == 21  or backup.status == 30 %}
                                                    <a @click="downloadTransferLog('{{ backup.id }}')"
                                                       class="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Log File
                                                    </a>
{#                                                    {% if backup.show_dir_tree %}#}
{##}
{#                                                        <a @click="downloadDirTree('{{ backup.id }}')"#}
{#                                                           class="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">#}
{#                                                            Dir Tree#}
{#                                                        </a>#}
{#                                                    {% endif %}#}
                                                {% endif %}
                                            {% endif %}
                                            {% if backup.show_db_log_file and object.type == 4 %}
                                                {% if backup.status == 3 or backup.status == 4 or backup.status == 11 or backup.status == 12 or backup.status == 13 or backup.status == 15  or backup.status == 20  or backup.status == 16  or backup.status == 19  or backup.status == 21  or backup.status == 30  %}
                                                    <a @click="downloadTransferLog('{{ backup.id }}')"
                                                       class="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Log File
                                                    </a>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            {% endif %}
{#                                          <button @click="retryBackup('{{ backup.id }}')" type="button"#}
{#                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">#}
{#                                                    Retry#}
{#                                                </button>#}
{#                                            {% if backup.show_transfer_log and object.type == 4 %}#}
{#                                                {% if backup.status == 3 or backup.status == 4 or backup.status == 11 or backup.status == 12 or backup.status == 13 or backup.status == 15  or backup.status == 20  or backup.status == 16 %}#}
{#                                                    <a @click="downloadTransferLog('{{ backup.id }}')"#}
{#                                                       class="cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">#}
{#                                                        Transfer Log#}
{#                                                    </a>#}
{#                                                {% endif %}#}
{#                                            {% endif %}#}
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                {% endfor %}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>

                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <nav class="border-t border-gray-200 px-4 flex items-center justify-between sm:px-0 mt-4">
                <div class="-mt-px w-0 flex-1 flex">
                    {% if page.has_previous %}
                        <a href="{% url 'console:node:detail' object.id %}?p_no={{ page.previous_page_number }}&p_size={{ page.paginator.per_page }}{% if list_all_backups %}&list_all_backups={{ list_all_backups }}{% endif %}#section-backup"
                           class="border-t-2 border-transparent pt-4 pr-1 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300">
                            <!-- Heroicon name: solid/arrow-narrow-left -->
                            <svg class="mr-3 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                 viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                      d="M7.707 14.707a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 010-1.414l4-4a1 1 0 011.414 1.414L5.414 9H17a1 1 0 110 2H5.414l2.293 2.293a1 1 0 010 1.414z"
                                      clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                            </svg>
                            Previous
                        </a>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                <div class="hidden md:-mt-px md:flex">
                    {% for page_no in elided_page_range %}
                        <!-- Current: "border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600", Default: "border-transparent text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300" -->
                        {% if page_no == "…" %}
                            <a class="{% if page.number ==  page_no %}border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600{% else %}border-transparent text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300{% endif %} border-t-2 pt-4 px-4 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                                {{ page_no }}
                            </a>
                        {% else %}
                            <a href="{% url 'console:node:detail' object.id %}?p_no={{ page_no }}&p_size={{ page.paginator.per_page }}{% if list_all_backups %}&list_all_backups={{ list_all_backups }}{% endif %}&#section-backup"
                               class="{% if page.number ==  page_no %}border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600{% else %}border-transparent text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300{% endif %} border-t-2 pt-4 px-4 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                                {{ page_no }}
                            </a>
                        {% endif %}
                    {% endfor %}
                </div>
                <div class="-mt-px w-0 flex-1 flex justify-end">
                    {% if page.has_next %}
                        <a href="{% url 'console:node:detail' object.id %}?p_no={{ page.next_page_number }}&p_size={{ page.paginator.per_page }}{% if list_all_backups %}&list_all_backups={{ list_all_backups }}{% endif %}&#section-backup"
                           class="border-t-2 border-transparent pt-4 pl-1 inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300">
                            Next
                            <!-- Heroicon name: solid/arrow-narrow-right -->
                            <svg class="ml-3 h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                 viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                      d="M12.293 5.293a1 1 0 011.414 0l4 4a1 1 0 010 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L14.586 11H3a1 1 0 110-2h11.586l-2.293-2.293a1 1 0 010-1.414z"
                                      clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </a>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </nav>
        {% endif %}

        <div x-show="openBackup" style="display: none;" class="fixed z-10 inset-0 overflow-y-auto"
             aria-labelledby="modal-title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
            <div class="flex items-end justify-center min-h-screen pt-4 px-4 pb-20 text-center sm:block sm:p-0">
                <div x-show="openBackup"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                     class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity" aria-hidden="true"></div>

                <span class="hidden sm:inline-block sm:align-middle sm:h-screen" aria-hidden="true">&#8203;</span>

                <div x-show="openBackup"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     class="inline-block align-bottom bg-white rounded-lg px-4 pt-5 pb-4 text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl transform transition-all sm:my-8 sm:align-middle sm:max-w-lg sm:w-full sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <div class="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-indigo-500">
                            <svg x-show="loading" class="animate-spin h-10 w-10 text-white"
                                 xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor"
                                        stroke-width="4"></circle>
                                <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor"
                                      d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                 fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M8 9l3 3-3 3m5 0h3M5 20h14a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Create {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}Backup{% else %}
                                Snapshot{% endif %}
                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    You are about to create on-demand
                                    {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                        backup{% else %}snapshot{% endif %} of <br/><strong>{{ object.name }}</strong>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Requesting {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                Backup{% else %}
                                Snapshot{% endif %}...
                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    Requesting on-demand
                                    {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}backup{% else %}
                                        snapshot{% endif %} for <br/><strong>{{ object.name }}</strong>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                            <div x-show="!loading" class="sm:col-span-6  mt-4">
                                <h4 class="font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Storage Locations (<span x-text="onDemandBackup.storage_point_ids.length"></span>)
                                </h4>
                                <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    Select where you want to store backups for this
                                    {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}backup{% else %}
                                        snapshot{% endif %} run.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                            <div x-show="!loading" class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <fieldset class="overflow-auto h-48">
                                    <div class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                        {% for storage in storage_list %}
                                            <div class="relative flex items-start py-2 px-1">
                                                <div class="flex items-center h-5">
                                                    <input id="ondemand-storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                           aria-describedby="ondemand-storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                           name="storage-{{ storage.id }}" type="checkbox"
                                                           value="{{ storage.id }}"
                                                           x-model="onDemandBackup.storage_point_ids"
                                                           class="focus:ring-indigo-500 h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 border-gray-300 rounded">
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="ml-3 text-sm">
                                                    <label for="ondemand-storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                           class="font-medium text-gray-700">{{ storage.name }}
                                                        {% if storage.type.code == "bs" %}
                                                            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800"> Default </span>
                                                        {% endif %}
                                                    </label>
                                                    {% if storage.type.code != "bs" %}
                                                        (<a @click="validateStorage('{{ storage.id }}', '{{ storage.type.code }}')"
                                                           class="text-indigo-700 cursor-pointer">validate</a>)
                                                    {% endif %}
                                                    <p id="comments-description"
                                                       class="text-gray-700">{{ storage.type.name }}</p>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </div>
                                </fieldset>
                                <p x-show="onDemandBackupErrors.storage_point_ids" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                   id="email-error" x-text="onDemandBackupErrors.storage_point_ids"></p>
                            </div>
                        {% endif %}
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-left sm:mt-5">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">

                                Backups{% else %}

                        <div x-show="loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Transfer {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                Backups{% else %}
                                Snapshots{% endif %}
                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    Requesting transfer for backup <br/><span x-text="backup.uuid"></span>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-left sm:mt-5">

                                <div class="sm:col-span-6  mt-4">
                                    <h4 class="font-medium text-gray-700">
                                        Storage Locations (<span x-text="transferBackup.storage_point_ids.length"></span>)
                                    </h4>
                                    <p class="mt-1 mb-4 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                        Select where you want to transfer backups. Select one or more.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                                <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                    <fieldset class="overflow-auto h-48">
                                        <div class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                            {% for storage in storage_list %}
                                                <div class="relative flex items-start py-2 px-1">
                                                    <div class="flex items-center h-5">
                                                        <input id="storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               aria-describedby="storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               name="storage-{{ storage.id }}" type="checkbox"
                                                               value="{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               x-model="transferBackup.storage_point_ids"
                                                               class="focus:ring-indigo-500 h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 border-gray-300 rounded">
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 text-sm">
                                                        <label for="storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               class="font-medium text-gray-700">{{ storage.name }}
                                                            {% if storage.type.code == "bs" %}
                                                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-red-600 text-white"> Depreciated </span>
                                                            {% endif %}
                                                        </label>
                                                        {% if storage.type.code != "bs" %}
                                                            (<a @click="validateStorage('{{ storage.id }}', '{{ storage.type.code }}')"
                                                               class="text-indigo-700 cursor-pointer">validate</a>)
                                                        {% endif %}
                                                        <p id="comments-description"
                                                           class="text-gray-700">{{ storage.type.name }}</p>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            {% endfor %}
                                        </div>
                                    </fieldset>
                                    <p x-show="transferErrors.storage_point_ids" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                       id="email-error" x-text="transferErrors.storage_point_ids"></p>
                                </div>
                            {% endif %}

                            </div>
                        </div>
