                                                Day-of-week fields in the same cron expression. If you specify a value
                                                or a
                                                * (asterisk) in one of the fields, you must use a ? (question mark) in
                                                the
                                                other.  <a target="_blank"
                                                   href="https://support.backupsheep.com/docs/backup-schedule-types#examples"
                                                   class="whitespace-nowrap font-medium text-blue-700 hover:text-blue-600">
                                                    Examples
                                                    <span aria-hidden="true"> &rarr;</span>
                                                </a></p>

                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div x-show="schedule.type=='cron'" class="sm:col-span-2">
                                <label for="first-name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Minute
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <input x-model="schedule.minute" type="text" name="minute" id="minute"
                                           autocomplete="minute"
                                           class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.minute" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="email-error"
                                       x-text="scheduleErrors.minute"></p>

                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div x-show="schedule.type=='cron'" class="sm:col-span-2">
                                <label for="first-name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Hour
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <input x-model="schedule.hour" type="text" name="hour" id="hour" autocomplete="hour"
                                           class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.hour" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="email-error"
                                       x-text="scheduleErrors.hour"></p>

                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div x-show="schedule.type=='cron'" class="sm:col-span-2">
                                <label for="first-name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Day-of-month
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <input x-model="schedule.day_of_month" type="text" name="day_of_month"
                                           id="day_of_month" autocomplete="day_of_month"
                                           class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.day_of_month" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                       id="email-error" x-text="scheduleErrors.day_of_month"></p>

                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div x-show="schedule.type=='cron'" class="sm:col-span-2">
                                <label for="first-name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Month
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <input x-model="schedule.month_of_year" type="text" name="month_of_year"
                                           id="month_of_year" autocomplete="month_of_year"
                                           class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.month_of_year" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                       id="email-error" x-text="scheduleErrors.month_of_year"></p>

                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div x-show="schedule.type=='cron'" class="sm:col-span-2">
                                <label for="first-name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Day-of-week
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <input x-model="schedule.day_of_week" type="text" name="day_of_week"
                                           id="day_of_month" autocomplete="day_of_week"
                                           class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.day_of_week" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                       id="email-error" x-text="scheduleErrors.day_of_week"></p>

                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div x-show="schedule.type=='cron'" class="sm:col-span-2">
                                <label for="first-name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Year
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <input x-model="schedule.year" type="text" name="year"
                                           id="year" autocomplete="year"
                                           class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.year" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                       id="email-error" x-text="scheduleErrors.year"></p>

                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="sm:col-span-6" x-show="schedule.type=='cron' && (schedule.minute === '*' || schedule.minute === '*/1')">
                                <div class="rounded-md bg-blue-50 p-4">
                                    <div class="flex">
                                        <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                                            <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-blue-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                 viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                                <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                      d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z"
                                                      clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                            </svg>
                                        </div>
                                        <div class="ml-3 flex-1 md:flex md:justify-between">
                                            <p class="text-sm text-blue-700">Using <strong
                                                    x-text="schedule.minute">*</strong> in the minute box means that the
                                                schedule will <br/><strong>run every minute</strong>. Please make sure
                                                you give
                                                backup enough time to finish
                                                so backups don't overlap.</p>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {% if object.website.backup_type != 2 and object.website.backup_type != 3 %}
                                <div class="sm:col-span-6 ">
                                    <h3 class="text-base font-medium text-gray-900">
                                        Retention Policy
                                    </h3>
                                    <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                        Leave empty to keep all backups created by this schedule. Otherwise enter number
                                        of
                                        backups you want to keep.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                                <div class="sm:col-span-2">
                                    <label for="first-name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                        Number of {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                        Backups{% else %}
                                        Snapshots{% endif %}
                                    </label>
                                    <div class="mt-1">
                                        <input x-model="schedule.keep_last" type="number" name="keep_last"
                                               id="keep_last"
                                               autocomplete="keep_last"
                                               class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                        <p x-show="scheduleErrors.keep_last" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                           id="email-error" x-text="scheduleErrors.keep_last"></p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            {% endif %}

                            <div class="sm:col-span-6 ">
                                <h3 class="text-base font-medium text-gray-900">
                                    Timezone
                                </h3>
                                <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    Select timezone in which you want this schedule to run.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <div class="relative">
                                    <button @click="toggleTimezoneDropdown()"
                                            type="button"
                                            class="relative w-full bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm pl-3 pr-10 py-2 text-left cursor-default focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm"
                                            aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="true"
                                            aria-labelledby="listbox-label">
                                              <span class="block truncate"
                                                    x-text="schedule.timezone||'--Choose Timezone--'">

                                              </span>
                                        <span class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center pr-2 pointer-events-none">
                                                <!-- Heroicon name: solid/selector -->
                                                <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                     viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                                  <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                        d="M10 3a1 1 0 01.707.293l3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 5.414 7.707 7.707a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414l3-3A1 1 0 0110 3zm-3.707 9.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 14.586l2.293-2.293a1 1 0 011.414 1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-3-3a1 1 0 010-1.414z"
                                                        clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                                </svg>
                                              </span>
                                    </button>

                                    <ul
                                            x-show="openTimezone"
                                            @click.self="toggleTimezoneDropdown()"
                                            x-transition:enter=""
                                            x-transition:enter-start=""
                                            x-transition:enter-end=""
                                            x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-100"
                                            x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                                            x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                                            class="absolute z-10 mt-1 w-full bg-white shadow-lg max-h-60 rounded-md py-1 text-base ring-1 ring-black ring-opacity-5 overflow-auto focus:outline-none sm:text-sm"
                                            tabindex="-1"
                                            role="listbox"
                                            aria-labelledby="listbox-label" aria-activedescendant="listbox-option-3">
                                        <!--
                                          Select option, manage highlight styles based on mouseenter/mouseleave and keyboard navigation.

                                          Highlighted: "text-white bg-indigo-600", Not Highlighted: "text-gray-700"
                                        -->
                                        {% for timezone in timezones %}
                                            <li
                                                    @click="schedule.timezone = '{{ timezone }}';toggleTimezoneDropdown()"
                                                    @mouseenter="timezoneActiveIndex = '{{ forloop.counter }}'"
                                                    @mouseleave="timezoneActiveIndex = null"
                                                    :class="{ 'text-white bg-indigo-600': timezoneActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}', 'text-gray-700': !(timezoneActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}') }"
                                                    class="cursor-default select-none relative py-2 pl-8 pr-4"
                                                    id="listbox-option-0" role="option">
                                                <!-- Selected: "font-semibold", Not Selected: "font-normal" -->
                                                <span class="font-normal block truncate">
                                                  {{ timezone }}
                                            </span>

                                                <!--
                                                  Checkmark, only display for selected option.
                                                  Highlighted: "text-white", Not Highlighted: "text-indigo-600"
                                                -->
                                                <span
                                                        x-show="schedule.timezone === '{{ timezone }}'"
                                                        :class="{ 'text-indigo-600': (schedule.timezone === '{{ timezone }}') && (timezoneActiveIndex !== '{{ forloop.counter }}'), 'text-white': (!(schedule.timezone === '{{ timezone }}') || (timezoneActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}')) }"
                                                        class="text-indigo-600 absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-1.5">
                                                  <!-- Heroicon name: solid/check -->
                                                  <svg class="h-5 w-5" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                       viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                          d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z"
                                                          clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                                  </svg>
                                                </span>
                                            </li>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </ul>
                                </div>
                                <p x-show="scheduleErrors.timezone" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="email-error"
                                   x-text="scheduleErrors.timezone"></p>
                            </div>

                            {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}
                                <div class="sm:col-span-6  mt-4">
                                    <h4 class="font-medium text-gray-700">
                                        Storage Locations (<span x-text="schedule.storage_point_ids.length"></span>)
                                    </h4>
                                    <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">
                                        Select where you want to store backups created by this schedule. Select one or
                                        more.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                                <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                    <fieldset class="overflow-auto h-48">
                                        <div class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                            {% for storage in storage_list %}
                                                <div class="relative flex items-start py-2 px-1">
                                                    <div class="flex items-center h-5">
                                                        <input id="storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               aria-describedby="storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               name="storage-{{ storage.id }}" type="checkbox"
                                                               value="{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               x-model="schedule.storage_point_ids"
                                                               class="focus:ring-indigo-500 h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 border-gray-300 rounded">
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="ml-3 text-sm">
                                                        <label for="storage-{{ storage.id }}"
                                                               class="font-medium text-gray-700">{{ storage.name }}
                                                            {% if storage.type.code == "bs" %}
                                                            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800"> Default </span>
                                                            {% endif %}
                                                        </label>
                                                        {% if storage.type.code != "bs" %}
                                                            (
                                                            <a @click="validateStorage('{{ storage.id }}', '{{ storage.type.code }}')"
                                                               class="text-indigo-700 cursor-pointer">validate</a>)
                                                        {% endif %}
                                                        <p id="comments-description"
                                                           class="text-gray-700">{{ storage.type.name }}</p>
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>
                                            {% endfor %}
                                        </div>
                                    </fieldset>
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.storage_point_ids" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                       id="email-error" x-text="scheduleErrors.storage_point_ids"></p>
                                </div>
                            {% endif %}

                            <div class="sm:col-span-6 mt-4">
                                <label for="about" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Notes
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                        <textarea x-model="schedule.notes" id="about" name="about" rows="3"
                                                  class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-md"></textarea>
                                    <p x-show="scheduleErrors.notes" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="email-error"
                                       x-text="scheduleErrors.notes"></p>
                                </div>
                                <p class="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-700">Optional notes about the schedule.</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-5 sm:mt-6 sm:grid sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-3 sm:grid-flow-row-dense">
                        <button @click="saveSchedule()" type="button"
                                class="w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-base font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:col-start-2 sm:text-sm">
                            <span x-show="!schedule.id">Create Schedule</span>
                            <span x-show="schedule.id">Modify Schedule</span>
                        </button>
{#                        <button disabled type="button"#}
{#                                class="w-full disabled inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-base font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:col-start-2 sm:text-sm">#}
{#                            <span >Maintenance In Progress</span>#}
{#                        </button>#}
                        <button @click="closeScheduleModal()" type="button"
                                class="mt-3 w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-white text-base font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:mt-0 sm:col-start-1 sm:text-sm">
                            Cancel
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div x-show="openModify" style="display: none;" class="fixed z-10 inset-0 overflow-y-auto"
             aria-labelledby="modal-title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
            <div class="flex items-end justify-center min-h-screen pt-4 px-4 pb-20 text-center sm:block sm:p-0">
                <div x-show="openModify"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                     class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity" aria-hidden="true"></div>

                <span class="hidden sm:inline-block sm:align-middle sm:h-screen" aria-hidden="true">&#8203;</span>

                <div x-show="openModify"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     class="inline-block align-bottom bg-white rounded-lg px-4 pt-5 pb-4 text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl transform transition-all sm:my-8 sm:align-middle sm:max-w-lg sm:w-full sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <div class="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-indigo-500">
                            <svg x-show="loading" class="animate-spin h-10 w-10 text-white"
                                 xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor"
                                        stroke-width="4"></circle>
                                <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor"
                                      d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            {% if object.type == 1 %}
                                <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M3 15a4 4 0 004 4h9a5 5 0 10-.1-9.999 5.002 5.002 0 10-9.78 2.096A4.001 4.001 0 003 15z"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 2 %}
                                <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M20 13V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v7m16 0v5a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-5m16 0h-2.586a1 1 0 00-.707.293l-2.414 2.414a1 1 0 01-.707.293h-3.172a1 1 0 01-.707-.293l-2.414-2.414A1 1 0 006.586 13H4"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 3 %}
                                <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M5 12h14M5 12a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h14a2 2 0 012 2v4a2 2 0 01-2 2M5 12a2 2 0 00-2 2v4a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2m-2-4h.01M17 16h.01"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 4 %}
                                <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                          d="M4 7v10c0 2.21 3.582 4 8 4s8-1.79 8-4V7M4 7c0 2.21 3.582 4 8 4s8-1.79 8-4M4 7c0-2.21 3.582-4 8-4s8 1.79 8 4m0 5c0 2.21-3.582 4-8 4s-8-1.79-8-4"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% elif object.type == 5 %}
                                <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                     fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                          d="M4 5a1 1 0 011-1h14a1 1 0 011 1v2a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1V5zM4 13a1 1 0 011-1h6a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6zM16 13a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v6a1 1 0 01-1 1h-2a1 1 0 01-1-1v-6z"></path>
                                </svg>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Modify Node
                            </h3>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-y-6 gap-x-4 sm:grid-cols-6">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <label for="name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                    Name
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <input x-model="node.name" type="text" name="node-name" id="name"
                                           autocomplete="node-name"
                                           class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md">
                                    <p x-show="modifyErrors?.name" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                       id="node-name-error" x-text="modifyErrors?.name"></p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-5 sm:mt-6 sm:grid sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-3 sm:grid-flow-row-dense">
                        <button @click="modifyNode()" type="button"
                                class="w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-base font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:col-start-2 sm:text-sm">
                            <span>Modify Node</span>
                        </button>
                        <button @click="closeModifyModal()" type="button"
                                class="mt-3 w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-white text-base font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:mt-0 sm:col-start-1 sm:text-sm">
                            Cancel
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div x-show="openIncrementalReset" style="display: none;" class="fixed z-10 inset-0 overflow-y-auto"
             aria-labelledby="modal-title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
            <div class="flex items-end justify-center min-h-screen pt-4 px-4 pb-20 text-center sm:block sm:p-0">
                <div x-show="openIncrementalReset"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                     class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity" aria-hidden="true"></div>

                <span class="hidden sm:inline-block sm:align-middle sm:h-screen" aria-hidden="true">&#8203;</span>

                <div x-show="openIncrementalReset"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     class="inline-block align-bottom bg-white rounded-lg px-4 pt-5 pb-4 text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl transform transition-all sm:my-8 sm:align-middle sm:max-w-lg sm:w-full sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <div class="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-indigo-500">
                            <svg x-show="loading" class="animate-spin h-10 w-10 text-white"
                                 xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor"
                                        stroke-width="4"></circle>
                                <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor"
                                      d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            <svg x-show="!loading" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                                 fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M8 9l3 3-3 3m5 0h3M5 20h14a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Please Confirm
                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    This action will reset file history for {{ object.website.get_backup_type_display }} backups for this node and your next
                                    backup will be a full-backup. Only use this option if you want to reset the file
                                    history or if you deleted your full backup.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Reset Incremental Backup
                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    Reset {{ object.website.get_backup_type_display }} backup for <br/><strong>{{ object.name }}</strong>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-5 sm:mt-6 sm:grid sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-3 sm:grid-flow-row-dense">
                        <button @click="incrementalReset()" type="button"
                                class="w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-base font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:col-start-2 sm:text-sm">
                            Reset {{ object.website.get_backup_type_display }} Backup
                        </button>
                        <button @click="closeIncrementalResetModal()" type="button"
                                class="mt-3 w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-white text-base font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:mt-0 sm:col-start-1 sm:text-sm">
                            Cancel
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.magic('clipboard', () => subject => {
                Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                    show: true,
                    success: true,
                    heading: 'Copied!',
                    details: subject
                });
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(subject)
            });

            Alpine.data('nodeDetails', (notifyOnSuccess, notifyOnFail) => ({
                list_all_backups: false,
                notify_on_success: (notifyOnSuccess === 'true'),
                notify_on_fail: (notifyOnFail === 'true'),
                node_id: document.getElementById('node-id').text,
                location_id: document.getElementById('location-id').text,
                node: {},
                openBackup: false,
                openPauseBackups: false,
                openResumeBackups: false,
                openDeleteNode: false,
                openIncrementalReset: false,
                openBackupDownload: false,
                openBackupTransfer: false,
                openSchedule: false,
                openModify: false,
                openTimezone: false,
                openBackupDelete: false,
                node_name: null,
                notes: null,
                loading: null,
                timezoneActiveIndex: null,
                backup: {},
                onDemandBackup: {
                    storage_point_ids: [],
                },
                transferBackup: {
                    storage_point_ids: [],
                },
                onDemandBackupErrors: {},
                backupErrors: {},
                modifyErrors: {},
                transferErrors: {
                    storage_point_ids: null,
                },
                scheduleErrors: {
                    timezone: null,
                    day_of_month: null,
                    day_of_week: null,
                    hour: null,
                    minute: null,
                    month_of_year: null,
                    name: null,
                    keep_last: null,
                    notes: null,
                    storage_point_ids: null,
                },
                schedule: {
                    timezone: null,
                    day_of_month: null,
                    day_of_week: null,
                    hour: null,
                    minute: null,
                    month_of_year: null,
                    name: null,
                    keep_last: null,
                    notes: null,
                    storage_point_ids: [],
                },
                init() {
                    console.log(notifyOnFail);
                    let url = new URL(window.location.href);
                    let params = new URLSearchParams(url.search.slice(1));

                    {% if object.type == 1 or object.type == 2 %}
                        this.validateNode();
                    {% endif %}

                    $(document).ready(function () {
                        let scheduleTypeOptions = [
                            {
                                id: '1',
                                text: 'Cron'
                            },
                            {
                                id: '2',
                                text: 'Rate'
                            },
                            {
                                id: '3',
                                text: 'One-time'
                            }
                        ];
                        /**
                         * Initiate Dropdown
                         */
                        $("#schedule-type").select2({
                            data: scheduleTypeOptions,
                        });
                    });
                },
                toggleBackups() {
                    this.list_all_backups = !this.list_all_backups;
                    let url = new URL(window.location.href);
                    let params = new URLSearchParams(url.search.slice(1));

                    if (this.list_all_backups) {
                        if (!params.has("list_all_backups")) {
                            params.append('list_all_backups', true);
                            url.search = params.toString();
                            window.location.href = url.toString();
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (params.has("list_all_backups")) {
                            params.delete('list_all_backups');
                            /**
                             * Remove pagination params because after removing flag pagination will change.
                             */
                            params.delete('p_no');
                            params.delete('p_size');
                            url.search = params.toString();
                            window.location.href = url.toString();
                        }
                    }
                },
                openBackupModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openBackup = true;
                    this.notes = null;
                },
                closeBackupModal() {
                    this.openBackup = false;
                    this.onDemandBackupErrors = {};
                },
                openPauseBackupsModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openPauseBackups = true;
                    this.notes = null;
                },
                closePauseBackupsModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openPauseBackups = false;
                },
                openResumeBackupsModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openResumeBackups = true;
                    this.notes = null;
                },
                closeResumeBackupsModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openResumeBackups = false;
                },
                openDeleteNodeModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openDeleteNode = true;
                    this.notes = null;
                },
                closeDeleteNodeModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openDeleteNode = false;
                },
                openIncrementalResetModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openIncrementalReset = true;
                    this.notes = null;
                },
                closeIncrementalResetModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openIncrementalReset = false;
                },
                openBackupDownloadModal(backupID, BackupUUID) {
                    this.backup = {};
                    this.openBackupDownload = true;
                    this.backup.id = backupID;
                    this.backup.uuid = BackupUUID;
                    this.getBackupStoragePoints(backupID);
                },
                closeBackupDownloadModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openBackupDownload = false;
                },

                openBackupTransferModal(storagePoint) {
                    this.transferBackup.storagePoint = storagePoint;
                    this.closeBackupDownloadModal();
                    this.openBackupTransfer = true;
                },

                closeBackupTransferModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.transferBackup = {};
                    this.openBackupTransfer = false;
                },
                openBackupCancelModal(integration, id, uuid) {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openBackupCancel = true;
                    this.backup.integration = integration;
                    this.backup.id = id;
                    this.backup.uuid = uuid;

                },
                closeBackupCancelModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openBackupCancel = false;
                },
                crontabShortcut(minute, hour, day_of_month, month_of_year, day_of_week) {
                    this.schedule.minute = minute;
                    this.schedule.hour = hour;
                    this.schedule.day_of_month = day_of_month;
                    this.schedule.month_of_year = month_of_year;
                    this.schedule.day_of_week = day_of_week;
                },
                openBackupDeleteModal(integration, id, uuid) {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openBackupDelete = true;
                    this.backup.integration = integration;
                    this.backup.id = id;
                    this.backup.uuid = uuid;
                },
                closeBackupDeleteModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openBackupDelete = false;
                },
                async openScheduleModal(schedule_id) {
                    this.notes = null;
                    if (schedule_id) {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        this.loading = true;
                        let url = "/api/v1/schedules/" + schedule_id + "/?" + new URLSearchParams({
                            location: this.location_id,
                        });

                        let params = {};
                        params.location = this.location_id;

                        /**
                         * We need to get details of schedule so we will make GET call.
                         * @type {Response}
                         */
                        let response = await fetch(url, {
                            headers: {
                                'Accept': 'application/json',
                                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                            },
                            method: 'GET',
                        }).then(async (response) => {
                            if (response.ok) {
                                return response.json();
                            } else {
                                this.loading = false;
                                let json;
                                try {
                                    json = await response.json();
                                } catch (exception_var) {
                                    json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                                }

                                this.scheduleErrors = json;
                                throw new Error(json.detail);
                            }
                        }).then((json) => {
                            {#Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({show: true, success: true, heading: 'Success!', details: json.detail});#}
                            this.schedule = json;
                            this.loading = false;
                            this.openSchedule = true;
                            Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                            {#this.closeScheduleModal();#}
                        }).catch((error) => {
                            Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                show: true,
                                error: true,
                                heading: 'Error!',
                                details: error.message
                            });
                            Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                            {#this.closeScheduleModal();#}
                        });
                    } else {
                        this.schedule = {
                            timezone: null,
                            day_of_month: null,
                            day_of_week: null,
                            hour: null,
                            minute: null,
                            month_of_year: null,
                            name: null,
                            keep_last: null,
                            notes: null,
                            storage_point_ids: [],
                        };
                        this.schedule.id = null;
                        this.schedule.type = 'rate';
                        this.schedule.rate_unit = 'hours';
                        this.loading = false;
                        this.openSchedule = true;
                    }
                },
                closeScheduleModal() {
                    this.openSchedule = false;
                    this.scheduleErrors = {
                        timezone: null,
                        day_of_month: null,
                        day_of_week: null,
                        hour: null,
                        minute: null,
                        month_of_year: null,
                        name: null,
                        keep_last: null,
                        notes: null,
                        storage_point_ids: null,
                    }
                },
                async openModifyModal() {
                    this.loading = true;

                    this.openModify = true;

                    let url = "/api/v1/nodes/" + "{{ object.id }}" + "/";

                    /**
                     * We need to get details of schedule so we will make GET call.
                     * @type {Response}
                     */
                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'GET',
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        this.loading = false;

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            this.scheduleErrors = json;
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        this.node = json;
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });

                },
                async modifyNode() {
                    this.loading = true;

                    let url = "/api/v1/nodes/" + "{{ object.id }}" + "/";
                    let data = {name: this.node?.name};

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        this.loading = false;

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            this.modifyErrors = json;
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        this.closeModifyModal();
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                closeModifyModal() {
                    this.openModify = false;
                },
                toggleTimezoneDropdown() {
                    this.openTimezone = !this.openTimezone;
                    this.timezoneActiveIndex = null;
                },
                async createBackup() {
                    this.loading = true;

                    let url = "/api/proxy/nodes/" + this.node_id + "/take_snapshot/?" + new URLSearchParams({
                        location: this.location_id,
                    });


                    let data = {
                        location: this.location_id,
                        notes: this.onDemandBackup.notes,
                        storage_point_ids: this.onDemandBackup.storage_point_ids,
                    }

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        this.loading = false;
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            this.onDemandBackupErrors = json;
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        this.closeBackupModal();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                /**
                 * Pause Backups
                 * @returns {Promise<void>}
                 */
                async pauseBackups() {
                    this.loading = true;

                    let url = "/api/v1/nodes/" + this.node_id + "/pause/";

                    let data = {
                        notes: this.notes,
                    }

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        this.closePauseBackupsModal();
                        location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                        this.closePauseBackupsModal();
                    });
                },
                /**
                 * Resume Backups
                 * @returns {Promise<void>}
                 */
                async resumeBackups() {
                    this.loading = true;

                    let url = "/api/v1/nodes/" + this.node_id + "/resume/";

                    let data = {
                        notes: this.notes,
                    }

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        this.closeResumeBackupsModal();
                        location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                        this.closeResumeBackupsModal();
                    });
                },

                /**
                 * Resume Backups
                 * @returns {Promise<void>}
                 */
                async cancelBackup(backupID) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                    let url = "/api/proxy/backups/{{object.connection.integration.code|lower}}/" + backupID + "/cancel" + "/?" + new URLSearchParams({
                        location: this.location_id,
                    });

                    let data = {
                        location: this.location_id,
                    }

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return {
                                "detail": "{% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}Backup{% else %}Snapshot{% endif %} will be canceled soon."
                            };
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },

                /**
                 * Retry Backups
                 * @returns {Promise<void>}
                 */
                async retryBackup(backupID) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                    let url = "/api/v1/backups/{{object.connection.integration.code|lower}}/" + backupID + "/retry" + "/?" + new URLSearchParams({
                        location: this.location_id,
                    });

                    let data = {
                        location: this.location_id,
                    }

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return {
                                "detail": "{% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}Backup{% else %}Snapshot{% endif %} will be canceled soon."
                            };
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },


                async getBackupStoragePoints() {
                    this.loading = true;

                    let url = "/api/v1/backups/{{object.connection.integration.code|lower}}/" + this.backup.id + "/storage_points/";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'GET',
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        this.loading = false;
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        this.backup.storagePoints = json;
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },

                async downloadBackup(storagePoint, type) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                    let url = "/api/v1/backups/{{object.connection.integration.code|lower}}/" + this.backup.id + "/download/?" + new URLSearchParams({
                        storage_point_id: storagePoint.id,
                    });

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'GET',
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        let data = json;

                        if (data.url === "restore_requested") {
                            let detail = '>We\'ve started moving your backup from cold storage to hot storage to download. Your link will be ready within the next 1-5 minutes.';
                            Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                show: true,
                                success: true,
                                heading: 'Success!',
                                details: detail
                            });
                        } else if (data.url === "restore_in_progress") {
                            let detail = 'Your backup is being moved from cold storage to hot storage to download. Your link will be ready within the next 1-5 minutes.';
                            Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                show: true,
                                success: true,
                                heading: 'Success!',
                                details: detail
                            });
                        } else if (data.url === "download_requested") {
                            this.closeBackupDownloadModal();
                            let detail = 'You download will be ready in few minutes and you will get email with download link.';
                            Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                show: true,
                                success: true,
                                heading: 'Success!',
                                details: detail
                            });
                        } else {
                            let url = '';
                            url = data.url
                            if (type === "copy") {
                                navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
                                Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                    show: true,
                                    success: true,
                                    heading: 'Copied!',
                                    details: url
                                });
                            } else {
                                window.open(url);
                            }
                            Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                                show: true,
                                success: true,
                                heading: 'Success!',
                                details: json.detail
                            });
                        }
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },

                /**
                 * Create or Update Schedule. If there's ID then we will make update request, otherwise add request
                 * @returns {Promise<void>}
                 */
                async saveSchedule() {
                    this.loading = true;
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                    let url = "/api/v1/schedules/";
                    let method = "POST";

                    if (this.schedule.id) {
                        url += this.schedule.id + "/";
                        method = "PATCH";
                    }

                    let data = this.schedule;
                    data.node = this.node_id;
                    data.location = this.location_id;

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method,
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            this.loading = false;
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            this.scheduleErrors = json;
                            json.detail = this.scheduleErrors.non_field_errors[0];
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        this.closeScheduleModal();
                        location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        {#this.closeScheduleModal();#}
                    });
                },
