                              d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z"></path>
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                              d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
          Account
        </span>
                </a>
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:multifactor' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                         class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6" fill="none"
                         viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                         stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                              d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                      Multi-Factor Auth
                    </span>
                </a>
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:password' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <!-- Heroicon name: outline/key -->
                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                         aria-hidden="true">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M15 7a2 2 0 012 2m4 0a6 6 0 01-7.743 5.743L11 17H9v2H7v2H4a1 1 0 01-1-1v-2.586a1 1 0 01.293-.707l5.964-5.964A6 6 0 1121 9z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
          Password
        </span>
                </a>

                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:billing' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <!-- Heroicon name: outline/credit-card -->
                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                         aria-hidden="true">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M3 10h18M7 15h1m4 0h1m-7 4h12a3 3 0 003-3V8a3 3 0 00-3-3H6a3 3 0 00-3 3v8a3 3 0 003 3z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
          Plan &amp; Billing
        </span>
                </a>
{% if not is_appsumo_plan %}
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:group' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <!-- Heroicon name: outline/user-group -->
                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                         aria-hidden="true">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                      Groups
                    </span>
                </a>
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:user' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                         class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                         stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                              d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                      Users
                    </span>
                </a>
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:invite' %}"
                   class="bg-gray-50 text-indigo-700 hover:text-indigo-700 hover:bg-white group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                         class="text-indigo-500 group-hover:text-indigo-500 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         fill="none"
                         viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                              d="M10 6H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v9a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-5m-4 0V5a2 2 0 114 0v1m-4 0a2 2 0 104 0m-5 8a2 2 0 100-4 2 2 0 000 4zm0 0c1.306 0 2.417.835 2.83 2M9 14a3.001 3.001 0 00-2.83 2M15 11h3m-3 4h2"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                      Invites
                    </span>
                </a>

                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:notification' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                         aria-hidden="true">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M17 14v6m-3-3h6M6 10h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zm10 0h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zM6 20h2a2 2 0 002-2v-2a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                                      Notifications
                                    </span>
                </a>
            {% endif %}
                {% if account.billing.plan.name == "AppSumo" %}
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:appsumo' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                             class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                  d="M15 5v2m0 4v2m0 4v2M5 5a2 2 0 00-2 2v3a2 2 0 110 4v3a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-3a2 2 0 110-4V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      AppSumo
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
            </nav>
        </aside>

        <div class="space-y-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-0 lg:col-span-9">


            {% if account.invites.all.count > 0 %}
                <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                    <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                        <div>
                            <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                Invitations </h2>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">You have the option to extend invitations to other
                                users for accessing your account.</p>
                        </div>

                        <div class="rounded-md bg-blue-50 p-4">
                            <div class="flex">
                                <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                                    <!-- Heroicon name: solid/information-circle -->
                                    <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-blue-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                         viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                        <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                              d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z"
                                              clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                    </svg>
                                </div>
                                <div class="ml-3 flex-1 md:flex md:justify-between">
                                    <p class="text-sm text-blue-700">Once the user accepts the invite, you can manage
                                        their settings on the users page.</p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                            <div class="col-span-6">
                                <table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Name
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Status
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Email
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Groups
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col" class="relative px-4 py-3">

                                        </th>
                                    </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    {% for invite in account.invites.all %}
                                        <tr>

                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ invite.full_name }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ invite.get_status_display }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ invite.email }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    <ul>
                                                        {% for group in invite.groups.all %}
                                                            <li><a class="cursor-pointer"
                                                                   @click="getGroup('{{ group.id }}', true)">{{ group.name }}</a>
                                                                <small>({{ group.get_type_display }})</small></li>
                                                        {% endfor %}
                                                    </ul>

                                                </div>
                                            </td>

                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                                {% if invite.status != 1 %}
                                                    <button @click="getInvite('{{ invite.id }}')" type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Modify
                                                    </button>
                                                    <button @click="deleteInvite('{{ invite.id }}')" type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Delete
                                                    </button>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>

                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}


            {% if invites_received.count > 0 %}
                <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                    <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                        <div>
                            <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                Invites Received</h2>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">You can accept invites sent by other accounts
                                here.</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                            <div class="col-span-6">
                                <table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Account
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Invited By
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Groups
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Status
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col" class="relative px-4 py-3">

                                        </th>
                                    </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    {% for invite in invites_received %}
                                        <tr>

                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ invite.account.name|default:"n/a" }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ invite.added_by.full_name }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {% for group in invite.groups.all %}
                                                        {{ group.name }} <small>({{ group.get_type_display }})</small>
                                                    {% endfor %}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ invite.get_status_display }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>

                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                                {% if invite.status == 4 %}
                                                    <button @click="acceptInvite('{{ invite.id }}')" type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Accept
                                                    </button>
                                                    <button @click="rejectInvite('{{ invite.id }}')" type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Reject
                                                    </button>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>

                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                            <span x-show="invite.id">Modify</span>
                            <span x-show="!invite.id">Create</span>
                            Invitation
                        </h2>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">You have the ability to invite new users to the account
                            and modify their group affiliations.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="rounded-md bg-blue-50 p-4">
                        <div class="flex">
                            <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                                <!-- Heroicon name: solid/information-circle -->
                                <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-blue-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                     viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                          d="M18 10a8 8 0 11-16 0 8 8 0 0116 0zm-7-4a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zM9 9a1 1 0 000 2v3a1 1 0 001 1h1a1 1 0 100-2v-3a1 1 0 00-1-1H9z"
                                          clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                            <div class="ml-3 flex-1 md:flex md:justify-between">
                                <p class="text-sm text-blue-700">Once the user accepts the invite, you can manage
                                    their settings on the users page.</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="first_name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">First Name</label>
                            <input x-model="invite.first_name" type="text" name="first_name" id="first_name"
                                   autocomplete="first_name"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="inviteErrors.first_name" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="first_name-error"
                               x-text="inviteErrors.first_name"></p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="last_name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Last Name</label>
                            <input x-model="invite.last_name" type="text" name="last_name" id="last_name"
                                   autocomplete="last_name"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="inviteErrors.last_name" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="last_name-error"
                               x-text="inviteErrors.last_name"></p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="email" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Email</label>
                            <input x-model="invite.email" type="email" name="email" id="email"
                                   autocomplete="email"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="inviteErrors.email" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="email-error"
                               x-text="inviteErrors.email"></p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-6">
                            <label for="groups" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Groups</label>
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <fieldset class="overflow-auto h-56">
                                    <div class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                        {% for enrollment in enrollments %}
                                            <div class="relative flex items-start py-4 px-1">
                                                <div class="flex items-center h-5">
                                                    <input id="user-group-{{ enrollment.id }}"
                                                           aria-describedby="user-group-{{ enrollment.id }}"
                                                           name="user-group-{{ enrollment.id }}" type="checkbox"
                                                           value="{{ enrollment.id }}"
                                                           x-model="invite.groups"
                                                           class="focus:ring-indigo-500 h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600 border-gray-300 rounded">
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="ml-3 text-sm">
                                                    <label for="user-group-{{ enrollment.id }}"
                                                           class="font-medium text-gray-700">{{ enrollment.name }}
                                                        <small>({{ enrollment.get_type_display }})</small>
                                                        {% if enrollment.default %}
                                                            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-purple-100 text-purple-800"> Default </span>
                                                        {% endif %}
                                                    </label>
                                                </div>
                                                <div class="ml-3 text-sm">
                                                    <button @click="getGroup('{{ enrollment.id }}', true)"
                                                            type="button"
                                                            class="float-right rounded  border border-gray-300 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 bg-white shadow-sm focus-visible:outline hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Details
                                                    </button>
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </div>
                                </fieldset>
                                <p x-show="inviteErrors.groups" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                                   id="groups-error" x-text="inviteErrors.groups"></p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 text-right sm:px-6">
                    <button @click="saveInvite(invite.id)"
                            class="bg-indigo-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                        <span x-show="invite.id">Modify Invite</span>
                        <span x-show="!invite.id">Create Invite</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div x-show="openGroup" style="display: none;" class="fixed z-10 inset-0 overflow-y-auto"
             aria-labelledby="modal-title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
            <div class="flex items-end justify-center min-h-screen pt-4 px-4 pb-20 text-center sm:block sm:p-0">
                <div x-show="openGroup"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                     class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity" aria-hidden="true"></div>

                <span class="hidden sm:inline-block sm:align-middle sm:h-screen" aria-hidden="true">&#8203;</span>

                <div x-show="openGroup"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     class="inline-block align-bottom bg-white rounded-lg px-4 pt-5 pb-4 text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl transform transition-all sm:my-8 sm:align-middle sm:max-w-lg sm:w-full sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <div class="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-indigo-500">
                            <svg x-show="loading" class="animate-spin h-10 w-10 text-white"
                                 xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor"
                                        stroke-width="4"></circle>
                                <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor"
                                      d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5"
                                 stroke="currentColor" class="h-6 w-6 text-white">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                      d="M18 18.72a9.094 9.094 0 003.741-.479 3 3 0 00-4.682-2.72m.94 3.198l.001.031c0 .225-.012.447-.037.666A11.944 11.944 0 0112 21c-2.17 0-4.207-.576-5.963-1.584A6.062 6.062 0 016 18.719m12 0a5.971 5.971 0 00-.941-3.197m0 0A5.995 5.995 0 0012 12.75a5.995 5.995 0 00-5.058 2.772m0 0a3 3 0 00-4.681 2.72 8.986 8.986 0 003.74.477m.94-3.197a5.971 5.971 0 00-.94 3.197M15 6.75a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2.25 2.25 0 11-4.5 0 2.25 2.25 0 014.5 0zm-13.5 0a2.25 2.25 0 11-4.5 0 2.25 2.25 0 014.5 0z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title"
                                x-text="groupView.name">

                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    The group permissions, notes and other details.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Loading group details...
                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    Requesting on-demand
                                    {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}backup{% else %}
                                        snapshot{% endif %} for <br/><strong>{{ object.name }}</strong>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-left sm:mt-5">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <label for="permissions" class="block text-base font-medium leading-7 text-gray-900">
                                    Permissions
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <ul role="list" class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                        <div class="overflow-y-auto h-56">

                                            <template x-for="permission in groupView.permission_details">
                                                <li class="relative bg-white px-2 py-3 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-inset focus-within:ring-indigo-600 hover:bg-gray-50">
                                                    <div class="flex justify-between space-x-3">
                                                        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                                                            <a href="#" class="block focus:outline-none">
                                                                    <span class="absolute inset-0"
                                                                          aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                                                <p class="truncate text-sm font-medium text-gray-900"
                                                                   x-text="permission.codename_alt"></p>
                                                            </a>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="mt-1">
                                                        <p class="line-clamp-2 text-sm text-gray-600"
                                                           x-text="permission.name"></p>
                                                    </div>
                                                </li>
                                            </template>
                                        </div>
                                        <!-- More messages... -->
                                    </ul>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-left sm:mt-5">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <label for="notes" class="block text-base font-medium leading-7 text-gray-900">
                                    Notes
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <textarea readonly x-model="groupView.notes" id="notes" name="notes" rows="3"
                                              class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-md"></textarea>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-5 sm:mt-6 sm:grid sm:gap-3 sm:grid-flow-row-dense">
                        <button @click="closeGroupModal()" type="button"
                                class="mt-3 w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-white text-base font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:mt-0 sm:col-start-1 sm:text-sm">
                            Close
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.magic('clipboard', () => subject => {
                Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                    show: true,
                    success: true,
                    heading: 'Copied!',
                    details: subject
                });
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(subject)
            });
            Alpine.data('settingsInvite', () => ({
                inviteErrors: {},
                invite: {
                    groups: []
                },
                loading: null,
                openGroup: null,
                groupView: {},
                openType: false,
                typeActiveIndex: null,
                init() {
                },
                async saveInvite(invite_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Saving invite details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/invites/";
                    let method = "POST";

                    if (invite_id) {
                        url = "/api/v1/invites/" + this.invite.id + "/";
                        method = "PATCH";
                    }

                    let data = this.invite

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method,
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.inviteErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async acceptInvite(invite_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Accepting invite.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/invites/" + invite_id + "/accept/";
                    let method = "GET";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.inviteErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async deleteInvite(invite_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Deleting invite details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/invites/" + invite_id + "/";
                    let method = "DELETE";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method,
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.status === 204) {
                            return {"detail": "Invite deleted."};
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async getInvite(invite_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Fetching invite details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/invites/" + invite_id + "/";
                    let method = "GET";


                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.inviteErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        this.invite = json;
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async getGroup(group_id, openGroup) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Fetching group details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/groups/" + group_id + "/";
                    let method = "GET";


                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.groupErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });

                        if (openGroup) {
                            this.groupView = json;
                            this.openGroupModal();
                        } else {
                            this.group = json;
                            this.permissions = json.permissions;
                            this.group.type = this.group.type.toString();
                            const element = document.getElementById("modify-add-group");
                            element.scrollIntoView();
                        }
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                openGroupModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openGroup = true;
                },
                closeGroupModal() {
                    this.openGroup = false;
                },
                toggleTypeDropdown() {
                    this.openType = !this.openType;
                    this.typeActiveIndex = null;
                },
                toggleNotification(notificationType) {
                    if (notificationType === "success") {
                        this.invite.notify_on_success = !this.invite.notify_on_success;
                    } else if (notificationType === "fail") {
                        this.invite.notify_on_fail = !this.invite.notify_on_fail;
                    }
                },
            }));
        });
    </script>

{% endblock %}
