                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                             class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                  d="M15 5v2m0 4v2m0 4v2M5 5a2 2 0 00-2 2v3a2 2 0 110 4v3a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-3a2 2 0 110-4V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      AppSumo
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
            </nav>
        </aside>

        <div class="space-y-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-0 lg:col-span-9">


            {% if account.enrollments.all.count > 0 %}
                <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                    <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                        <div>
                            <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                Groups
                                <button @click="createGroupScroll()" type="button"
                                        class="ml-2 rounded bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-indigo-600">
                                    Create Group
                                </button>
                            </h2>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Groups created by this account.</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                            <div class="col-span-6">
                                <table class="min-w-full table-auto	 divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Name
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Type
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Users
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Nodes
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col" class="relative px-4 py-3">

                                        </th>
                                    </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    {% for account_group in account.enrollments.all %}
                                        <tr>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ account_group.name }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ account_group.get_type_display }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ account_group.member_count }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>

                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ account_group.node_count }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>

                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                                {% if not account_group.default %}
                                                    <button @click="getGroup('{{ account_group.id }}', true)"
                                                            type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Details
                                                    </button>
                                                    <button @click="getGroup('{{ account_group.id }}')" type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Modify
                                                    </button>
                                                    <button @click="deleteGroup('{{ account_group.id }}')" type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Delete
                                                    </button>
                                                {% endif %}
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>

                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md" id="modify-add-group">
                <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                            <span x-show="!group.id">Create</span>
                            <span x-show="group.id">Modify</span>
                            Group
                        </h2>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">You can manage Team and Client groups here.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Name</label>
                            <input x-model="group.name" type="text" name="name" id="name"
                                   autocomplete="name"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="groupErrors.name" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="name-error"
                               x-text="groupErrors.name"></p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="country" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Type</label>
                            <div class="relative">
                                <button @click="toggleTypeDropdown()"
                                        type="button"
                                        class="relative w-full bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm pl-3 pr-10 py-2 text-left cursor-default focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm"
                                        aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="true" aria-labelledby="listbox-label">
                                              <span class="block truncate"
                                                    x-text="typeName(group.type)">

                                              </span>
                                    <span class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center pr-2 pointer-events-none">
                                                    <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-gray-400"
                                                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                         viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                                      <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                            d="M10 3a1 1 0 01.707.293l3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 5.414 7.707 7.707a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414l3-3A1 1 0 0110 3zm-3.707 9.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 14.586l2.293-2.293a1 1 0 011.414 1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-3-3a1 1 0 010-1.414z"
                                                            clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                                    </svg>
                                                </span>
                                </button>
                                <template x-if="openType">
                                    <ul
                                            x-show="openType"
                                            @click.self="toggleTypeDropdown()"
                                            x-transition:enter=""
                                            x-transition:enter-start=""
                                            x-transition:enter-end=""
                                            x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-100"
                                            x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                                            x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                                            class="absolute z-10 mt-1 w-full bg-white shadow-lg max-h-60 rounded-md py-1 text-base ring-1 ring-black ring-opacity-5 overflow-auto focus:outline-none sm:text-sm"
                                            tabindex="-1" role="listbox"
                                            aria-labelledby="listbox-label" aria-activedescendant="listbox-option-3">
                                        {% for type in types %}
                                            <li
                                                    @click="group.type = '{{ type.0 }}';toggleTypeDropdown()"
                                                    @mouseenter="typeActiveIndex = '{{ forloop.counter }}'"
                                                    @mouseleave="typeActiveIndex = null"
                                                    :class="{ 'text-white bg-indigo-600': typeActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}', 'text-gray-700': !(typeActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}') }"
                                                    class="cursor-default select-none relative py-2 pl-8 pr-4"
                                                    id="listbox-option-0" role="option">
                                                <span class="font-normal block truncate">
                                                  {{ type.1 }}
                                            </span>
                                                <span
                                                        x-show="group.type === '{{ type.0 }}'"
                                                        :class="{ 'text-indigo-600': (group.type === '{{ type.0 }}') && (typeActiveIndex !== '{{ forloop.counter }}'), 'text-white': (!(group.type === '{{ type.0 }}') || (typeActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}')) }"
                                                        class="text-indigo-600 absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-1.5">
                                                  <svg class="h-5 w-5" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                       viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                          d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z"
                                                          clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                                  </svg>
                                                </span>
                                            </li>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </ul>
                                </template>
                            </div>
                            <p x-show="groupErrors.type" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="email-error"
                               x-text="groupErrors.type"></p>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <div class="flex items-center mt-14">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5"
                                 stroke="currentColor" class="w-6 h-6">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                      d="M16.5 10.5V6.75a4.5 4.5 0 10-9 0v3.75m-.75 11.25h10.5a2.25 2.25 0 002.25-2.25v-6.75a2.25 2.25 0 00-2.25-2.25H6.75a2.25 2.25 0 00-2.25 2.25v6.75a2.25 2.25 0 002.25 2.25z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            <h2 id="profile-notifications" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">

                                Permissions
                            </h2>
                        </div>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">These permissions will only apply to nodes within this
                            group.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="px-4">
                        <fieldset class="border-b border-t border-gray-200">
                            <legend class="sr-only">Notifications</legend>
                            <div class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                <div class="relative flex items-start pb-4 pt-3.5">
                                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-6">
                                        <label for="backup_create" class="font-medium text-gray-900 cursor-pointer">On-Demand
                                            Backups</label>
                                        <p id="backup_create-description" class="text-gray-500">Users can create
                                            on-demand
                                            backups of nodes.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3 flex h-6 items-center">
                                        <button type="button"
                                                @click="permissions.backup_create=!permissions.backup_create"
                                                :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.backup_create, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.backup_create) }"
                                                class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                                role="switch" aria-checked="false"
                                                aria-labelledby="backup_create-label">
                                            <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.backup_create, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.backup_create) }"
                                                  aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                        </button>

                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div class="relative flex items-start pb-4 pt-3.5">
                                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-6">
                                        <label for="backup_download" class="font-medium text-gray-900 cursor-pointer">Download
                                            Backups</label>
                                        <p id="backup_download-description" class="text-gray-500">Users can download
                                            backups of
                                            nodes in this group.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3 flex h-6 items-center">
                                        <button type="button"
                                                @click="permissions.backup_download=!permissions.backup_download"
                                                :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.backup_download, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.backup_download) }"
                                                class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                                role="switch" aria-checked="false"
                                                aria-labelledby="backup_download-label">
                                            <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.backup_download, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.backup_download) }"
                                                  aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="relative flex items-start pb-4 pt-3.5">
                                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-6">
                                        <label for="backup_delete" class="font-medium text-gray-900 cursor-pointer">Delete
                                            Backups</label>
                                        <p id="backup_delete-description" class="text-gray-500">Users can delete backups
                                            of
                                            nodes in this group.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3 flex h-6 items-center">
                                        <button type="button"
                                                @click="permissions.backup_delete=!permissions.backup_delete"
                                                :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.backup_delete, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.backup_delete) }"
                                                class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                                role="switch" aria-checked="false"
                                                aria-labelledby="backup_delete-label">
                                            <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.backup_delete, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.backup_delete) }"
                                                  aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="relative flex items-start pb-4 pt-3.5">
                                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-6">
                                        <label for="schedule_changes" class="font-medium text-gray-900 cursor-pointer">Schedule
                                            Changes</label>
                                        <p id="schedule_changes-description" class="text-gray-500">Users can create,
                                            modify and
                                            delete backup schedules.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3 flex h-6 items-center">
                                        <button type="button"
                                                @click="permissions.schedule_changes=!permissions.schedule_changes"
                                                :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.schedule_changes, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.schedule_changes) }"
                                                class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                                role="switch" aria-checked="false"
                                                aria-labelledby="schedule_changes-label">
                                            <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.schedule_changes, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.schedule_changes) }"
                                                  aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="relative flex items-start pb-4 pt-3.5">
                                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-6">
                                        <label for="node_changes" class="font-medium text-gray-900 cursor-pointer">Node
                                            Changes</label>
                                        <p id="node_changes-description" class="text-gray-500">Users can create, modify
                                            and delete
                                            nodes.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3 flex h-6 items-center">
                                        <button type="button"
                                                @click="permissions.node_changes=!permissions.node_changes"
                                                :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.node_changes, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.node_changes) }"
                                                class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                                role="switch" aria-checked="false"
                                                aria-labelledby="node_changes-label">
                                            <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.node_changes, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.node_changes) }"
                                                  aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="relative flex items-start pb-4 pt-3.5">
                                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-6">
                                        <label for="integration_changes"
                                               class="font-medium text-gray-900 cursor-pointer">Integration
                                            Changes</label>
                                        <p id="integration_changes-description" class="text-gray-500">Users can create,
                                            modify and delete
                                            integrations.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3 flex h-6 items-center">
                                        <button type="button"
                                                @click="permissions.integration_changes=!permissions.integration_changes"
                                                :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.integration_changes, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.integration_changes) }"
                                                class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                                role="switch" aria-checked="false"
                                                aria-labelledby="integration_changes-label">
                                            <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.integration_changes, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.integration_changes) }"
                                                  aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                <div class="relative flex items-start pb-4 pt-3.5">
                                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm leading-6">
                                        <label for="storage_changes" class="font-medium text-gray-900 cursor-pointer">Storage
                                            Changes</label>
                                        <p id="storage_changes-description" class="text-gray-500">Users can create,
                                            modify and delete
                                            storage accounts.</p>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3 flex h-6 items-center">
                                        <button type="button"
                                                @click="permissions.storage_changes=!permissions.storage_changes"
                                                :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.storage_changes, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.storage_changes) }"
                                                class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                                role="switch" aria-checked="false"
                                                aria-labelledby="storage_changes-label">
                                            <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.storage_changes, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.storage_changes) }"
                                                  aria-hidden="true"
                                                  class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </fieldset>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <div class="flex items-center mt-14">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5"
                                 stroke="currentColor" class="w-6 h-6">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                      d="M14.857 17.082a23.848 23.848 0 005.454-1.31A8.967 8.967 0 0118 9.75v-.7V9A6 6 0 006 9v.75a8.967 8.967 0 01-2.312 6.022c1.733.64 3.56 1.085 5.455 1.31m5.714 0a24.255 24.255 0 01-5.714 0m5.714 0a3 3 0 11-5.714 0M3.124 7.5A8.969 8.969 0 015.292 3m13.416 0a8.969 8.969 0 012.168 4.5"></path>
                            </svg>

                            <h2 id="notifications" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900 ml-1">
                                Notification
                            </h2>
                        </div>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">These notification settings will override any user level
                            notification settings in this group.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-6">

                        <div class="">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <!-- Enabled: "bg-indigo-600", Not Enabled: "bg-gray-200" -->
                                <button type="button"
                                        @click="toggleNotification('success')"
                                        :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.notify_on_success, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.notify_on_success) }"
                                        class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                        role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                    <!-- Enabled: "translate-x-5", Not Enabled: "translate-x-0" -->
                                    <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.notify_on_success, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.notify_on_success) }"
                                          aria-hidden="true"
                                          class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                </button>
                                <span class="ml-3" id="annual-billing-label">
                                        <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Backup Success</span>
                                    </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <button type="button"
                                        @click="toggleNotification('fail')"
                                        :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': permissions.notify_on_fail, 'bg-gray-200': !(permissions.notify_on_fail) }"
                                        class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                        role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                        <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': permissions.notify_on_fail, 'translate-x-0': !(permissions.notify_on_fail) }"
                                              aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                </button>

                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                      d="M15.666 3.888A2.25 2.25 0 0013.5 2.25h-3c-1.03 0-1.9.693-2.166 1.638m7.332 0c.055.194.084.4.084.612v0a.75.75 0 01-.75.75H9a.75.75 0 01-.75-.75v0c0-.212.03-.418.084-.612m7.332 0c.646.049 1.288.11 1.927.184 1.1.128 1.907 1.077 1.907 2.185V19.5a2.25 2.25 0 01-2.25 2.25H6.75A2.25 2.25 0 014.5 19.5V6.257c0-1.108.806-2.057 1.907-2.185a48.208 48.208 0 011.927-.184"></path>
                            </svg>

                            <h2 id="notifications" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">

                    <div>

                                                                 class="block w-full rounded-md border-0 text-gray-900 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-inset ring-gray-300 placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-indigo-600 sm:py-1.5 sm:text-sm sm:leading-6"></textarea>

                        <span x-show="group.id">Modify Group</span>
                        <span x-show="!group.id">Create Group</span>

            </div>

        </div>

        <div x-show="openGroup" style="display: none;" class="fixed z-10 inset-0 overflow-y-auto"
             aria-labelledby="modal-title" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
            <div class="flex items-end justify-center min-h-screen pt-4 px-4 pb-20 text-center sm:block sm:p-0">
                <div x-show="openGroup"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                     class="fixed inset-0 bg-gray-500 bg-opacity-75 transition-opacity" aria-hidden="true"></div>

                <span class="hidden sm:inline-block sm:align-middle sm:h-screen" aria-hidden="true">&#8203;</span>

                <div x-show="openGroup"
                     x-transition:enter="ease-out duration-300"
                     x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave="ease-in duration-200"
                     x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100 translate-y-0 sm:scale-100"
                     x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0 translate-y-4 sm:translate-y-0 sm:scale-95"
                     class="inline-block align-bottom bg-white rounded-lg px-4 pt-5 pb-4 text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl transform transition-all sm:my-8 sm:align-middle sm:max-w-lg sm:w-full sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <div class="mx-auto flex items-center justify-center h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-indigo-500">
                            <svg x-show="loading" class="animate-spin h-10 w-10 text-white"
                                 xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor"
                                        stroke-width="4"></circle>
                                <path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor"
                                      d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path>
                            </svg>
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke-width="1.5"
                                 stroke="currentColor" class="h-6 w-6 text-white">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                      d="M18 18.72a9.094 9.094 0 003.741-.479 3 3 0 00-4.682-2.72m.94 3.198l.001.031c0 .225-.012.447-.037.666A11.944 11.944 0 0112 21c-2.17 0-4.207-.576-5.963-1.584A6.062 6.062 0 016 18.719m12 0a5.971 5.971 0 00-.941-3.197m0 0A5.995 5.995 0 0012 12.75a5.995 5.995 0 00-5.058 2.772m0 0a3 3 0 00-4.681 2.72 8.986 8.986 0 003.74.477m.94-3.197a5.971 5.971 0 00-.94 3.197M15 6.75a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2.25 2.25 0 11-4.5 0 2.25 2.25 0 014.5 0zm-13.5 0a2.25 2.25 0 11-4.5 0 2.25 2.25 0 014.5 0z"></path>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title"
                                x-text="groupView.name">

                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    The group permissions, notes and other details.
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="loading" class="mt-3 text-center sm:mt-5">
                            <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700" id="modal-title">
                                Loading group details...
                            </h3>
                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-700">
                                    Requesting on-demand
                                    {% if object.type == 3 or object.type == 4 or object.type == 5 %}backup{% else %}
                                        snapshot{% endif %} for <br/><strong>{{ object.name }}</strong>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-left sm:mt-5">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <label for="permissions" class="block text-base font-medium leading-7 text-gray-900">
                                    Permissions
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <ul role="list" class="divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                        <div class="overflow-y-auto h-56">

                                            <template x-for="permission in groupView.permission_details">
                                                <li class="relative bg-white px-2 py-3 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-inset focus-within:ring-indigo-600 hover:bg-gray-50">
                                                    <div class="flex justify-between space-x-3">
                                                        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                                                            <a href="#" class="block focus:outline-none">
                                                                    <span class="absolute inset-0"
                                                                          aria-hidden="true"></span>
                                                                <p class="truncate text-sm font-medium text-gray-900"
                                                                   x-text="permission.codename_alt"></p>
                                                            </a>
                                                        </div>
                                                    </div>
                                                    <div class="mt-1">
                                                        <p class="line-clamp-2 text-sm text-gray-600"
                                                           x-text="permission.name"></p>
                                                    </div>
                                                </li>
                                            </template>
                                        </div>
                                        <!-- More messages... -->
                                    </ul>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-3 text-left sm:mt-5">
                            <div class="sm:col-span-6">
                                <label for="notes" class="block text-base font-medium leading-7 text-gray-900">
                                    Notes
                                </label>
                                <div class="mt-1">
                                    <textarea readonly x-model="groupView.notes" id="notes" name="notes" rows="3"
                                              class="shadow-sm focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block w-full sm:text-sm border border-gray-300 rounded-md"></textarea>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div x-show="!loading" class="mt-5 sm:mt-6 sm:grid sm:gap-3 sm:grid-flow-row-dense">
                        <button @click="closeGroupModal()" type="button"
                                class="mt-3 w-full inline-flex justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 shadow-sm px-4 py-2 bg-white text-base font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 sm:mt-0 sm:col-start-1 sm:text-sm">
                            Close
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('settingsGroup', () => ({
                loading: null,
                openGroup: null,
                groupErrors: {},
                groupView: {},
                group: {
                    notes: null,
                },
                permissions: {
                    notify_on_success: false,
                    notify_on_fail: false,
                    notify_via_email: false,
                    notify_via_slack: false,
                    notify_via_telegram: false,
                    backup_create: false,
                    backup_download: false,
                    backup_delete: false,
                    schedule_changes: false,
                    node_changes: false,
                    integration_changes: false,
                    storage_changes: false,
                },
                openType: false,
                typeActiveIndex: null,
                init() {
                },
                openGroupModal() {
                    this.loading = false;
                    this.openGroup = true;
                },
                closeGroupModal() {
                    this.openGroup = false;
                },
                createGroupScroll() {
                    this.group = {
                        notes: null,
                    }
                    this.permissions = {
                        notify_on_success: false,
                        notify_on_fail: false,
                        notify_via_email: false,
                        notify_via_slack: false,
                        notify_via_telegram: false,
                        backup_create: false,
                        backup_download: false,
                        backup_delete: false,
                        schedule_changes: false,
                        node_changes: false,
                        integration_changes: false,
                        storage_changes: false
                    }
                    const element = document.getElementById("modify-add-group");
                    element.scrollIntoView();
                },
                async saveGroup(group_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Saving group details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/groups/";
                    let method = "POST";

                    if (group_id) {
                        url = "/api/v1/groups/" + this.group.id + "/";
                        method = "PATCH";
                    }

                    const permissions = _.compact(_.map(this.permissions, function (value, prop) {
                        if (value) {
                            return prop;
                        }
                    }));

                    let data = this.group;
                    data.permissions = permissions;

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method,
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.groupErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async deleteGroup(group_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Deleting group details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/groups/" + group_id + "/";
                    let method = "DELETE";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method,
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.status === 204) {
                            return {"detail": "Group deleted."};
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async getGroup(group_id, openGroup) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Fetching group details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/groups/" + group_id + "/";
                    let method = "GET";


                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.groupErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });

                        if (openGroup) {
                            this.groupView = json;
                            this.openGroupModal();
                        } else {
                            this.group = json;
                            this.permissions = json.permissions;
                            this.group.type = this.group.type.toString();
                            const element = document.getElementById("modify-add-group");
                            element.scrollIntoView();
                        }
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                typeName(type) {
                    if (type === "1") {
                        return "Team"
                    } else if (type === "2") {
                        return "Client"
                    } else {
                        return "--Choose Group Type--"
                    }
                },
                toggleTypeDropdown() {
                    this.openType = !this.openType;
                    this.typeActiveIndex = null;
                },
                toggleNotification(notificationType) {
                    if (notificationType === "success") {
                        this.permissions.notify_on_success = !this.permissions.notify_on_success;
                    } else if (notificationType === "fail") {
                        this.permissions.notify_on_fail = !this.permissions.notify_on_fail;
                    } else if (notificationType === "email") {
                        this.permissions.notify_via_email = !this.permissions.notify_via_email;
                    } else if (notificationType === "slack") {
                        this.permissions.notify_via_slack = !this.permissions.notify_via_slack;
                    } else if (notificationType === "telegram") {
                        this.permissions.notify_via_telegram = !this.permissions.notify_via_telegram;
                    }
                },
            }));
        });
    </script>

{% endblock %}

                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"

                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
          Password

                <a  href="{% url 'console:settings:billing' %}"

{% if not is_appsumo_plan %}
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:group' %}#"

                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"

                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
          Groups
        </span>
                </a>
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:user' %}"

                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"

                         stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                              d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">

                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:invite' %}"

                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                              d="M10 6H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v9a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-5m-4 0V5a2 2 0 114 0v1m-4 0a2 2 0 104 0m-5 8a2 2 0 100-4 2 2 0 000 4zm0 0c1.306 0 2.417.835 2.83 2M9 14a3.001 3.001 0 00-2.83 2M15 11h3m-3 4h2"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">

                    </span>

             {% endif %}
                {% if account.billing.plan.name == "AppSumo" %}
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:appsumo' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"

                             fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                  d="M15 5v2m0 4v2m0 4v2M5 5a2 2 0 00-2 2v3a2 2 0 110 4v3a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-3a2 2 0 110-4V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      AppSumo
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
            {% if not is_appsumo_plan %}
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:notification' %}"
                   class="bg-gray-50 text-indigo-700 hover:text-indigo-700 hover:bg-white group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <svg class="text-indigo-500 group-hover:text-indigo-500 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"

                         aria-hidden="true">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M17 14v6m-3-3h6M6 10h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zm10 0h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zM6 20h2a2 2 0 002-2v-2a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                    </svg>
