            </nav>
        </aside>

        <div class="space-y-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-0 lg:col-span-9">
            <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md sm:overflow-hidden">
                <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-700">Notifications</h3>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">Backup notification settings and integrations with
                            third-party apps.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <a href="{{ slack_oauth_url }}"
                               style="align-items:center;color:#fff;background-color:#4A154B;border:0;border-radius:4px;display:inline-flex;font-family:Lato, sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;height:56px;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;width:276px">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="height:24px;width:24px;margin-right:12px"
                                     viewBox="0 0 122.8 122.8">
                                    <path d="M25.8 77.6c0 7.1-5.8 12.9-12.9 12.9S0 84.7 0 77.6s5.8-12.9 12.9-12.9h12.9v12.9zm6.5 0c0-7.1 5.8-12.9 12.9-12.9s12.9 5.8 12.9 12.9v32.3c0 7.1-5.8 12.9-12.9 12.9s-12.9-5.8-12.9-12.9V77.6z"
                                          fill="#e01e5a"></path>
                                    <path d="M45.2 25.8c-7.1 0-12.9-5.8-12.9-12.9S38.1 0 45.2 0s12.9 5.8 12.9 12.9v12.9H45.2zm0 6.5c7.1 0 12.9 5.8 12.9 12.9s-5.8 12.9-12.9 12.9H12.9C5.8 58.1 0 52.3 0 45.2s5.8-12.9 12.9-12.9h32.3z"
                                          fill="#36c5f0"></path>
                                    <path d="M97 45.2c0-7.1 5.8-12.9 12.9-12.9s12.9 5.8 12.9 12.9-5.8 12.9-12.9 12.9H97V45.2zm-6.5 0c0 7.1-5.8 12.9-12.9 12.9s-12.9-5.8-12.9-12.9V12.9C64.7 5.8 70.5 0 77.6 0s12.9 5.8 12.9 12.9v32.3z"
                                          fill="#2eb67d"></path>
                                    <path d="M77.6 97c7.1 0 12.9 5.8 12.9 12.9s-5.8 12.9-12.9 12.9-12.9-5.8-12.9-12.9V97h12.9zm0-6.5c-7.1 0-12.9-5.8-12.9-12.9s5.8-12.9 12.9-12.9h32.3c7.1 0 12.9 5.8 12.9 12.9s-5.8 12.9-12.9 12.9H77.6z"
                                          fill="#ecb22e"></path>
                                </svg>
                                Connect Slack</a>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <a href="#connect-telegram">
                                <img class="h-16" src="{{ STATIC_URL }}console/images/telegram.svg"></a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {% if notifications_slack.count > 0 %}
                <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                    <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                        <div>
                            <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                Slack Channels</h2>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">List of your Slack channels you connected.</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                            <div class="col-span-6">
                                <table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Team
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Channel
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col" class="relative px-4 py-3">

                                        </th>
                                    </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    {% for slack in notifications_slack %}
                                        <tr>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ slack.data.team.name }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ slack.channel }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                                <button @click="validateSlack('{{ slack.id }}')"
                                                        type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Validate
                                                </button>
                                                <button @click="removeSlack('{{ slack.id }}')"
                                                        type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Remove
                                                </button>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>

                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if notifications_telegram.count > 0 %}
                <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                    <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                        <div>
                            <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                Telegram Channels</h2>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">List of your Telegram channels you connected.</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                            <div class="col-span-6">
                                <table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Channel Name
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Channel ID
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col" class="relative px-4 py-3">

                                        </th>
                                    </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    {% for telegram in notifications_telegram %}
                                        <tr>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ telegram.channel_name }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                    {{ telegram.chat_id }}
                                                </div>
                                            </td>
                                            <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                                <button @click="validateTelegram('{{ telegram.id }}')"
                                                        type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Validate
                                                </button>
                                                <button @click="removeTelegram('{{ telegram.id }}')"
                                                        type="button"
                                                        class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                    Remove
                                                </button>
                                            </td>
                                        </tr>
                                    {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>

                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                            Add Telegram Channel</h2>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Please add BackupSheep Bot <a class="text-indigo-600"
                                                                                            href="t.me/backupsheep_bot"
                                                                                            target="_blank">backupsheep_bot</a>
                            to your channel as admin.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="channel_name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Channel
                                Name</label>
                            <input x-model="telegram.channel_name" type="text" name="channel_name" id="channel_name"
                                   autocomplete="channel_name"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="notificationErrors.channel_name" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                               id="channel_name-error"
                               x-text="notificationErrors.channel_name"></p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="chat_id" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Channel/Chat ID <span
                                    class="text-indigo-600">(<a
                                    href="https://community.jamaicans.dev/t/get-the-telegram-channel-id/427"
                                    target="_blank">how to find chat id?</a>)</span></label>
                            <input x-model="telegram.chat_id" type="text" name="chat_id" id="chat_id"
                                   autocomplete="chat_id"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="notificationErrors.chat_id" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="chat_id-error"
                               x-text="notificationErrors.chat_id"></p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 text-right sm:px-6">
                    <button id="connect-telegram" @click="addTelegram()"
                            class="bg-indigo-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                        <span>Add Channel</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('settingsNotifications', () => ({
                notificationErrors: {},
                telegram: {},
                init() {
                },
                async validateSlack(notification_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Validation...");

                    let url = "/api/v1/notifications-slack/" + notification_id + "/validate/";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'GET',
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async removeSlack(notification_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                    let url = "/api/v1/notifications-slack/" + notification_id + "/";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'DELETE',
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        if (response.status === 204) {
                            return {"detail": "Notification integration is deleted."};
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },

                async addTelegram() {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Saving invite details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/notifications-telegram/";
                    let method = "POST";

                    let data = this.telegram

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method,
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.notificationErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async validateTelegram(notification_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Validation...");

                    let url = "/api/v1/notifications-telegram/" + notification_id + "/validate/";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'GET',
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async removeTelegram(notification_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                    let url = "/api/v1/notifications-telegram/" + notification_id + "/";

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'DELETE',
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();
                        if (response.status === 204) {
                            return {"detail": "Notification integration is deleted."};
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
            }));
        });
    </script>

{% endblock %}
```

                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="password_confirm" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">New Password
                                (Confirm)</label>

                                   id="password_confirm"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="memberErrors.user.password_confirm" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600"
                               id="email-error" x-text="memberErrors.user.password_confirm"></p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 text-right sm:px-6">
                    <button @click="saveAccount()"
                            class="bg-indigo-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                        Change Password
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('settingsPassword', () => ({
                memberErrors: {
                    user: {},
                },
                member: {
                    id: {{ request.user.member.id }},
                    user: {
                        id: {{ request.user.id }},
                        password: "",
                        password_confirm: "",
                    },
                    auth_multi_factor_token: null
                },
                showPasswordChange: null,
                init() {

                },
                async saveAccount() {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Saving account details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/members/" + this.member.id + "/";

                    let data = this.member

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            this.memberErrors = json;
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },


            }));
        });
    </script>

                                  d="M10 6H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v9a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-5m-4 0V5a2 2 0 114 0v1m-4 0a2 2 0 104 0m-5 8a2 2 0 100-4 2 2 0 000 4zm0 0c1.306 0 2.417.835 2.83 2M9 14a3.001 3.001 0 00-2.83 2M15 11h3m-3 4h2"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      Invites
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
                {% if account.billing.plan.name == "AppSumo" %}
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:appsumo' %}"
                       class="bg-gray-50 text-indigo-700 hover:text-indigo-700 hover:bg-white group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                             class="text-indigo-500 group-hover:text-indigo-500 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                  d="M15 5v2m0 4v2m0 4v2M5 5a2 2 0 00-2 2v3a2 2 0 110 4v3a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-3a2 2 0 110-4V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      AppSumo
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
                {% if not is_appsumo_plan %}
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:notification' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                             aria-hidden="true">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                  d="M17 14v6m-3-3h6M6 10h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zm10 0h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zM6 20h2a2 2 0 002-2v-2a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                                          Notifications
                                        </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
            </nav>
        </aside>

        <div class="space-y-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-0 lg:col-span-9">

            <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <h3 class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                            Plan & Billing Management
                        </h3>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">BackupSheep partners with Stripe for simplified billing.
                            The Stripe portal allows you to self-manage their
                            payment details, invoices, and subscriptions in one place.</p>
                        {% if account.billing.is_legacy_plan %}
                            <div class="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-4 mt-8">
                                <div class="flex">
                                    <div class="flex-shrink-0">
                                        <!-- Heroicon name: mini/x-circle -->
                                        <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-red-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                             viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                            <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                  d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zM8.28 7.22a.75.75 0 00-1.06 1.06L8.94 10l-1.72 1.72a.75.75 0 101.06 1.06L10 11.06l1.72 1.72a.75.75 0 101.06-1.06L11.06 10l1.72-1.72a.75.75 0 00-1.06-1.06L10 8.94 8.28 7.22z"
                                                  clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                        </svg>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="ml-3">
                                        <h3 class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800">Notice for Accounts on Legacy Plans
                                            - Contact
                                            Support to switch to new plan.</h3>
                                        <div class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700">
                                            <ul role="list" class="list-disc space-y-1 pl-5">
                                                <li>Legacy plans
                                                    were in Candian Dollars so Stripe won't show new
                                                    US Dollar plans as upgrade option.
                                                </li>
                                                <li>
                                                    Contact support and in your support request mention the new plan
                                                    name and term.
                                                </li>
                                                <li>
                                                    Please make sure you have valid credit card on file.
                                                </li>
                                                <li>
                                                    You will get refund for unused time on your legacy plan.
                                                </li>
                                            </ul>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        {% endif %}

                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <a target="_blank" href="{{ stripe_customer_portal_url }}"
                               class="bg-indigo-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                Access Stripe Portal
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    {% if account.appsumo_code_count > 0 %}
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="appsumo_code" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Your AppSumo
                                Codes</label>
                            <dd class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-900 sm:mt-0 sm:col-span-2">
                                <ul role="list" class="border border-gray-200 rounded-md divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    {% for appsumo_code in account.appsumo_codes.all %}
                                        <li class="pl-3 pr-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                                            <div class="w-0 flex-1 flex items-center">
                                                <span class="ml-2 flex-1 w-0 truncate">
                                                    {{ appsumo_code.code }}
                                                </span>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="ml-4 flex-shrink-0">
                                                <a class="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-500">
                                                    {{ appsumo_code.get_status_display }}
                                                </a>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="ml-4 flex-shrink-0">
                                                <a class="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-500">
                                                    {{ appsumo_code.modified }}
                                                </a>
                                            </div>
                                        </li>
                                    {% endfor %}
                                </ul>
                            </dd>
                        </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
{% endblock %}
```

{% extends "console/_master.html" %}

{% block content %}

                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"

                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:multifactor' %}"

                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                         class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6" fill="none"
                         viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                         stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                              d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                      Multi-Factor Auth
                    </span>
                </a>
                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:password' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                         aria-hidden="true">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M15 7a2 2 0 012 2m4 0a6 6 0 01-7.743 5.743L11 17H9v2H7v2H4a1 1 0 01-1-1v-2.586a1 1 0 01.293-.707l5.964-5.964A6 6 0 1121 9z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                      Password
                    </span>
                </a>

                <a href="{% url 'console:settings:billing' %}"
                   class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                    <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                         aria-hidden="true">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M3 10h18M7 15h1m4 0h1m-7 4h12a3 3 0 003-3V8a3 3 0 00-3-3H6a3 3 0 00-3 3v8a3 3 0 003 3z"></path>
                    </svg>
                    <span class="truncate">
                      Plan &amp; Billing
                    </span>
                </a>
                {% if not is_appsumo_plan %}
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:group' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                             aria-hidden="true">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                  d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      Groups
                    </span>
                    </a>
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:user' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                             class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                             stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                  d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      Users
                    </span>
                    </a>
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:invite' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                             class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             fill="none"
                             viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                  d="M10 6H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v9a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-5m-4 0V5a2 2 0 114 0v1m-4 0a2 2 0 104 0m-5 8a2 2 0 100-4 2 2 0 000 4zm0 0c1.306 0 2.417.835 2.83 2M9 14a3.001 3.001 0 00-2.83 2M15 11h3m-3 4h2"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      Invites
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
                {% if account.billing.plan.name == "AppSumo" %}
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:appsumo' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                             class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
                                  d="M15 5v2m0 4v2m0 4v2M5 5a2 2 0 00-2 2v3a2 2 0 110 4v3a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-3a2 2 0 110-4V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      AppSumo
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
                {% if not is_appsumo_plan %}
                    <a href="{% url 'console:settings:notification' %}"
                       class="text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 group rounded-md px-3 py-2 flex items-center text-sm font-medium">
                        <svg class="text-gray-400 group-hover:text-gray-700 flex-shrink-0 -ml-1 mr-3 h-6 w-6"
                             xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"
                             aria-hidden="true">
                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                  d="M17 14v6m-3-3h6M6 10h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zm10 0h2a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2zM6 20h2a2 2 0 002-2v-2a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2z"></path>
                        </svg>
                        <span class="truncate">
                      Notifications
                    </span>
                    </a>
                {% endif %}
            </nav>
        </aside>

        <div class="space-y-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-0 lg:col-span-9">
            <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                            Account</h2>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Manage account specific information.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <label for="name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Name</label>
                            <input x-model="account.name" type="text" name="name" id="name"
                                   autocomplete="name"
                                   class="mt-1 block w-full border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm">
                            <p x-show="accountErrors.name" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="name-error"
                               x-text="accountErrors.name"></p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="profile-notifications" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900 mt-8">
                            Notifications
                        </h2>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Account level notification.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">

                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <!-- Enabled: "bg-indigo-600", Not Enabled: "bg-gray-200" -->
                                <button type="button"
                                        @click="toggleNotification('success')"
                                        :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': account.notify_on_success, 'bg-gray-200': !(account.notify_on_success) }"
                                        class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                        role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                    <!-- Enabled: "translate-x-5", Not Enabled: "translate-x-0" -->
                                    <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': account.notify_on_success, 'translate-x-0': !(account.notify_on_success) }"
                                          aria-hidden="true"
                                          class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                </button>
                                <span class="ml-3" id="annual-billing-label">
                                        <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Notify On Success </span>
                                    </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <button type="button"
                                        @click="toggleNotification('fail')"
                                        :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': account.notify_on_fail, 'bg-gray-200': !(account.notify_on_fail) }"
                                        class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                        role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                        <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': account.notify_on_fail, 'translate-x-0': !(account.notify_on_fail) }"
                                              aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                </button>
                                <span class="ml-3" id="annual-billing-label">
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Notify On Failure </span>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 text-right sm:px-6">
                    <button @click="saveAccount()"
                            class="bg-indigo-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                        Save Account Changes
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            {% if request.user.member.memberships.count > 1 and request.user.member.is_primary_account %}
                <div class="shadow sm:rounded-md">
                    <div class="bg-white py-6 px-4 space-y-6 sm:p-6">
                        <div>
                            <h2 id="payment-details-heading" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900">
                                Account Access</h2>
                            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">You have access to following accounts.</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">
                            <div class="col-span-6">
                                <table class="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                                    <tr>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Account
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Groups
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col"
                                            class="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                            Status
                                        </th>
                                        <th scope="col" class="relative px-4 py-3">

                                        </th>
                                    </tr>
                                    </thead>
                                    <tbody class="bg-white divide-y divide-gray-200">
                                    {% for membership in request.user.member.memberships.all %}
                                        {% if membership.account != account %}
                                            <tr>

                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                        {{ membership.account.name|default:membership.account.get_primary_member.full_name }}
                                                    </div>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                        {% for group in request.user.groups.all %}
                                                            {% if group.enrollment.get.account != account %}
                                                                {{ group.enrollment.get.name }}
                                                                <small>({{ group.enrollment.get.get_type_display }})</small>
                                                            {% endif %}
                                                        {% endfor %}
                                                    </div>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
                                                        {{ membership.get_status_display }}
                                                    </div>
                                                </td>
                                                <td class="px-4 py-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right text-sm font-medium">
                                                    <button @click="leaveMembership('{{ membership.id }}')"
                                                            type="button"
                                                            class="inline-flex items-center mx-auto px-2.5 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 shadow-sm text-sm leading-4 font-medium rounded-md text-gray-700 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                                                        Leave
                                                    </button>
                                                </td>
                                            </tr>
                                        {% endif %}
                                    {% endfor %}
                                    </tbody>
                                </table>

                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('settingsAccount', () => ({
                accountErrors: {
                    user: {},
                    timezone: null,
                },
                account: {
                    id: {{ account.id }},
                    {% autoescape off %}
                        name: "{{ account.name }}",
                    {% endautoescape %}
                    notify_on_success: {% if account.notify_on_success %}true{% else %}false{% endif %},
                    notify_on_fail: {% if account.notify_on_fail %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}
                },
                openTimezone: false,
                timezoneActiveIndex: null,
                init() {
                },
                async saveAccount() {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Saving account details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/accounts/" + this.account.id + "/";

                    let data = this.account;

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                async leaveMembership(membership_id) {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Leaving account...");

                    let url = "/api/v1/accounts/{{ account.id }}/leave_membership/";
                    let method = "POST";

                    let data = {"membership_id": membership_id}

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: method,
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                                this.userErrors = json;
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                toggleNotification(notificationType) {
                    if (notificationType === "success") {
                        this.account.notify_on_success = !this.account.notify_on_success;
                    } else if (notificationType === "fail") {
                        this.account.notify_on_fail = !this.account.notify_on_fail;
                    }
                },

                toggleTimezoneDropdown() {
                    this.openTimezone = !this.openTimezone;
                    this.timezoneActiveIndex = null;
                },
            }));
        });
    </script>

{% endblock %}
```

                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">

                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">

                                <button @click="toggleTimezoneDropdown()"
                                        type="button"
                                        class="relative w-full bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm pl-3 pr-10 py-2 text-left cursor-default focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 sm:text-sm"
                                        aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="true" aria-labelledby="listbox-label">
                                              <span class="block truncate"
                                                    x-text="member.timezone||'--Choose Timezone--'">

                                              </span>
                                    <span class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center pr-2 pointer-events-none">
                                                <!-- Heroicon name: solid/selector -->
                                                <svg class="h-5 w-5 text-gray-400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                     viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                                  <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                        d="M10 3a1 1 0 01.707.293l3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 5.414 7.707 7.707a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414l3-3A1 1 0 0110 3zm-3.707 9.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 14.586l2.293-2.293a1 1 0 011.414 1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-3-3a1 1 0 010-1.414z"
                                                        clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                                </svg>
                                              </span>
                                </button>
                                <template x-if="openTimezone">
                                    <ul
                                            x-show="openTimezone"
                                            @click.self="toggleTimezoneDropdown()"
                                            x-transition:enter=""
                                            x-transition:enter-start=""
                                            x-transition:enter-end=""
                                            x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-100"
                                            x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100"
                                            x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0"
                                            class="absolute z-10 mt-1 w-full bg-white shadow-lg max-h-60 rounded-md py-1 text-base ring-1 ring-black ring-opacity-5 overflow-auto focus:outline-none sm:text-sm"
                                            tabindex="-1" role="listbox"
                                            aria-labelledby="listbox-label" aria-activedescendant="listbox-option-3">
                                        <!--
                                          Select option, manage highlight styles based on mouseenter/mouseleave and keyboard navigation.

                                          Highlighted: "text-white bg-indigo-600", Not Highlighted: "text-gray-700"
                                        -->
                                        {% for timezone in timezones %}
                                            <li
                                                    @click="member.timezone = '{{ timezone }}';toggleTimezoneDropdown()"
                                                    @mouseenter="timezoneActiveIndex = '{{ forloop.counter }}'"
                                                    @mouseleave="timezoneActiveIndex = null"
                                                    :class="{ 'text-white bg-indigo-600': timezoneActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}', 'text-gray-700': !(timezoneActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}') }"
                                                    class="cursor-default select-none relative py-2 pl-8 pr-4"
                                                    id="listbox-option-0" role="option">
                                                <!-- Selected: "font-semibold", Not Selected: "font-normal" -->
                                                <span class="font-normal block truncate">
                                                  {{ timezone }}
                                            </span>

                                                <!--
                                                  Checkmark, only display for selected option.
                                                  Highlighted: "text-white", Not Highlighted: "text-indigo-600"
                                                -->
                                                <span
                                                        x-show="member.timezone === '{{ timezone }}'"
                                                        :class="{ 'text-indigo-600': (member.timezone === '{{ timezone }}') && (timezoneActiveIndex !== '{{ forloop.counter }}'), 'text-white': (!(member.timezone === '{{ timezone }}') || (timezoneActiveIndex === '{{ forloop.counter }}')) }"
                                                        class="text-indigo-600 absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-1.5">
                                                  <!-- Heroicon name: solid/check -->
                                                  <svg class="h-5 w-5" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                                                       viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                                                    <path fill-rule="evenodd"
                                                          d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z"
                                                          clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
                                                  </svg>
                                                </span>
                                            </li>
                                        {% endfor %}
                                    </ul>
                                </template>
                            </div>
                            <p x-show="memberErrors.timezone" class="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600" id="email-error"
                               x-text="memberErrors.timezone"></p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h2 id="profile-notifications" class="text-lg leading-6 font-medium text-gray-900 mt-8">
                            Notifications
                        </h2>
                        <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">Your notification settings across all accounts.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-6">

                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <!-- Enabled: "bg-indigo-600", Not Enabled: "bg-gray-200" -->
                                <button type="button"
                                        @click="toggleNotification('success')"
                                        :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': member.notify_on_success, 'bg-gray-200': !(member.notify_on_success) }"
                                        class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                        role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                    <!-- Enabled: "translate-x-5", Not Enabled: "translate-x-0" -->
                                    <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': member.notify_on_success, 'translate-x-0': !(member.notify_on_success) }"
                                          aria-hidden="true"
                                          class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                </button>
                                <span class="ml-3" id="annual-billing-label">
                                        <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Notify On Success </span>
                                    </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-span-6 sm:col-span-3">
                            <div class="flex items-center">
                                <button type="button"
                                        @click="toggleNotification('fail')"
                                        :class="{ 'bg-indigo-600': member.notify_on_fail, 'bg-gray-200': !(member.notify_on_fail) }"
                                        class="bg-gray-200 relative inline-flex flex-shrink-0 h-6 w-11 border-2 border-transparent rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors ease-in-out duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                                        role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-labelledby="annual-billing-label">
                                        <span :class="{ 'translate-x-5': member.notify_on_fail, 'translate-x-0': !(member.notify_on_fail) }"
                                              aria-hidden="true"
                                              class="translate-x-0 pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transform ring-0 transition ease-in-out duration-200"></span>
                                </button>
                                <span class="ml-3" id="annual-billing-label">
                                <span class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Notify On Failure </span>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 text-right sm:px-6">
                    <button @click="saveProfile()"
                            class="bg-indigo-600 border border-transparent rounded-md shadow-sm py-2 px-4 inline-flex justify-center text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500">
                        Save Profile Changes
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('alpine:init', () => {
            Alpine.data('settingsProfile', () => ({
                memberErrors: {
                    user: {},
                    timezone: null,
                },
                member: {
                    id: {{ request.user.member.id }},
                    user: {
                        id:{{ request.user.id }},
                        first_name: "{{ request.user.first_name }}",
                        last_name: "{{ request.user.last_name }}",
                        email: "{{ request.user.email }}"
                    },
                    timezone: "{{ request.user.member.timezone }}",
                    notify_on_success: {% if request.user.member.notify_on_success %}true{% else %}false{% endif %},
                    notify_on_fail: {% if request.user.member.notify_on_fail %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}
                },
                openTimezone: false,
                timezoneActiveIndex: null,
                init() {
                },
                async saveProfile() {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Saving account details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/members/" + this.member.id + "/";

                    let data = this.member

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }

                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
                toggleNotification(notificationType) {
                    if (notificationType === "success") {
                        this.member.notify_on_success = !this.member.notify_on_success;
                    } else if (notificationType === "fail") {
                        this.member.notify_on_fail = !this.member.notify_on_fail;
                    }
                },

                toggleTimezoneDropdown() {
                    this.openTimezone = !this.openTimezone;
                    this.timezoneActiveIndex = null;
                },
            }));
        });
    </script>

{% endblock %}
```

                    appsumo_code: null,

                init() {
                },
                async saveAccount() {
                    Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle("Saving account details.");

                    let url = "/api/v1/accounts/" + {{account.id}} +"/appsumo/";

                    let data = this.account

                    let response = await fetch(url, {
                        headers: {
                            'Accept': 'application/json',
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        },
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify(data)
                    }).then(async (response) => {
                        Alpine.store('showLoading').toggle();

                        if (response.ok) {
                            return response.json();
                        } else {
                            let json;
                            try {
                                json = await response.json();
                            } catch (exception_var) {
                                json = {detail: response.status + " - " + response.statusText + ". Please contact support."};
                            }
                            throw new Error(json.detail);
                        }
                    }).then((json) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            success: true,
                            heading: 'Success!',
                            details: json.detail
                        });
                        window.location.reload();
                    }).catch((error) => {
                        Alpine.store('notifications').items.push({
                            show: true,
                            error: true,
                            heading: 'Error!',
                            details: error.message
                        });
                    });
                },
            }));
        });
    </script>
